literature.headline_zh: 呼吸道合胞病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期重点文献按发表日期、相关性、证据等级和研究质量综合排序，研究结果与综述证据分别核验后形成以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 200 名患者(61.3%)中至少检测到一种呼吸道病毒。 [paper-7fd50e8f97164d10]
在 MATISSE 3 期试验中,疫苗接种在出生后 90 天内对严重 RSV 下呼吸道感染的功效为 81.8%,在 180 天内为 69.4%,同时减少了住院治疗。 [paper-c8000b73f26ae5f7]

与没有 RSV 住院的 RW/A 相比,RSV 相关的 RW/A 在 1-2 岁时吸入药物使用量较高,但在 4 岁后使用量较低,平均血液嗜酸性粒细胞较低(0.34 vs 0.39×109/L;p=0.003)。RSV 住院与兄弟姐妹中的 RW/A (OR 2.8;95% CI 2.4–3.2) 相关,并且 GWAS 在 APBB1IP 上识别出 RSV 关联 (rs787036;beta=0.209;p=8.80×10−9)。 [paper-de098e9f4e88170f]
在严格的 NPI 期间,整体病毒阳性率从 2020 年的 27.4% 下降至 2021 年的 14.5%,然后在放松后于 2023 年反弹至 35.1%,其中 A 型流感在 2022 年夏季非典型地卷土重来,并主导 2023 年冬季高峰,而 B 型流感则逐年增加,并于 2024 年达到峰值。 [paper-4cb83840124580a8]
结果 2022 年末和 2023 年初,iGAS 发病率显着增加,对儿童和老年人的影响尤为严重。 [paper-9ba9a44452bbb67c]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.caveats_zh: 部分证据来自摘要、观察性研究或叙述性综述，结论应结合研究设计和证据等级理解。
literature.lead_en: This literature brief prioritizes publications in the active reporting window and ranks them by relevance, evidence availability, study quality, recency and source convergence.
key_findings_en: At least one respiratory virus was detected in 200 patients (61.3%). [paper-7fd50e8f97164d10]

In the phase 3 MATISSE trial, vaccination demonstrated 81.8% efficacy against severe RSV lower respiratory tract infection within 90 days of birth and 69.4% within 180 days, alongside reductions in hospitalization. [paper-c8000b73f26ae5f7]

RSV-associated RW/A demonstrates higher inhaled medication use at ages 1–2 years but lower use after age 4, with lower mean blood eosinophils (0.34 vs 0.39×109/L; p=0.003) compared to RW/A without RSV hospitalization. [paper-de098e9f4e88170f]

Overall virus positivity declined from 27.4% in 2020 to 14.5% in 2021 during strict NPIs, then rebounded to 35.1% in 2023 after relaxation, with Flu A resurging atypically in summer 2022 and dominating the 2023 winter peak, while Flu B increased annually and peaked in 2024. [paper-4cb83840124580a8]
ResultsiGAS incidence markedly increased in late 2022 and early 2023, disproportionately affecting children and older adults. [paper-9ba9a44452bbb67c]
literature.trend_or_risk_en: The direction of this week's research is defined by the clinical, epidemiological, ecological, diagnostic and molecular topics actually represented by the eligible publications.
literature.caveats_en: Some evidence is abstract-only, observational or derived from narrative reviews; conclusions should be interpreted in light of study design and evidence strength.

news.headline_zh: 马来西亚RSV感染率居高不下,封闭社区环境传播风险显著。
news.lead_zh: 2026年7月中旬,呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)在马来西亚及全球儿童群体中引发持续关注。官方及权威媒体报告显示,RSV仍是婴幼儿最常见的呼吸道病原体,在封闭社区环境中的传播风险极高,且对医疗资源构成显著负担。
key_findings_zh: 马来西亚6个月以下婴儿中81.3%的病毒性呼吸道感染由RSV引起,84.5%的两岁以下感染儿童需住院治疗。
系统综述与荟萃分析显示,在有儿童的封闭社区环境中RSV传播风险显著,合并继发性发作率达23.8%,5岁以下儿童高达26.8%。
RSV可能导致肺炎及哮喘等长期呼吸道并发症,给医疗系统带来沉重负担。
研究强调需加强预防措施,包括母乳喂养、卫生习惯及疫苗接种,以降低社会经济影响。
news.trend_or_risk_zh: 当前RSV在儿童群体中的传播风险处于高位,特别是在家庭、幼儿教育及护理中心等封闭环境中。研究指出,年龄较小、出现症状及病毒排毒持续时间较长均会增加传播风险。专家呼吁家长及医疗机构提高警惕,采取包括母乳喂养和疫苗接种在内的综合预防策略,以减轻RSV爆发对儿童健康及医疗资源的冲击。
news.caveats_zh: 现有数据主要来源于系统综述和专家观点,缺乏实时官方监测数据支持。部分研究存在异质性(I2=96.9%),且纳入研究的质量参差不齐,需谨慎解读具体感染率和传播风险数值。
news.headline_en: High RSV Prevalence in Malaysia and Elevated Transmission Risk in Closed Communities.
news.lead_en: Mid-July 2026, Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) continues to draw attention in Malaysia and globally. Official and reputable reports indicate RSV remains the most common respiratory pathogen in infants, with significantly high transmission risks in closed community settings and a substantial burden on healthcare resources.
key_findings_en: RSV accounts for 81.3% of viral respiratory infections in infants under six months in Malaysia, with 84.5% of infected children under two requiring hospitalization.
A systematic review and meta-analysis found high RSV transmission risk in closed community settings with children, with a pooled secondary attack rate of 23.8% and 26.8% in children under five.
RSV can lead to severe complications like pneumonia and long-term respiratory issues such as asthma, placing a heavy burden on healthcare systems.
The study emphasizes the need for preventive measures, including breastfeeding, hygiene, and vaccination, to reduce the socioeconomic impact of RSV outbreaks.
news.trend_or_risk_en: The current risk of RSV transmission among children remains high, particularly in closed environments such as households, early childhood education and care centers. The study highlights that younger age, presence of symptoms, and longer viral shedding duration increase transmission risk. Experts urge parents and healthcare providers to enhance prevention strategies, including breastfeeding and vaccination, to mitigate the impact on child health and medical resources.
news.caveats_en: Current data relies primarily on systematic reviews and expert opinions, lacking real-time official surveillance data. Some studies exhibit substantial heterogeneity (I²=96.9%), and the quality of included studies varies, necessitating cautious interpretation of specific infection and transmission risk figures.
news.brief_en: In mid-July 2026, Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) remains a persistent threat to children in Malaysia and globally. Reports indicate RSV causes 81.3% of viral respiratory infections in infants under six months, with 84.5% of those under two requiring hospitalization. A systematic review and meta-analysis found high transmission risk in closed community settings, with a pooled secondary attack rate of 23.8% in children under five. RSV can lead to severe complications like pneumonia and asthma, placing a heavy burden on healthcare systems. Experts urge enhanced prevention measures, including breastfeeding and vaccination, to mitigate the impact on child health and medical resources.

papers.title: Maternal Immunization Against Respiratory Syncytial Virus: An Integrative Review of Efficacy, Safety, and Implementation
papers.abstract: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is a leading cause of severe lower respiratory tract infection in young infants and accounts for substantial morbidity, hospitalization, and mortality worldwide, with the highest burden concentrated in the first months of life, when immunological and anatomical immaturity favors severe disease. Maternal vaccination has emerged as a strategy to bridge this window of vulnerability through the transplacental transfer of neutralizing antibodies. This integrative review synthesizes scientific articles published between 2022 and 2026, including systematic reviews, meta-analyses, narrative reviews, and position statements from national and international scientific societies, addressing the epidemiology, clinical manifestations, diagnosis, mechanism of action, efficacy, safety, and public health impact of maternal RSV immunization. The bivalent prefusion F protein vaccine (RSVpreF; Abrysvo®), administered as a single intramuscular dose between 32 and 36 weeks of gestation, induces maternal IgG that is transferred to the fetus and confers passive protection during the first six months of life. In the phase 3 MATISSE trial, vaccination demonstrated 81.8% efficacy against severe RSV lower respiratory tract infection within 90 days of birth and 69.4% within 180 days, alongside reductions in hospitalization. The safety profile was favorable, with predominantly mild and transient adverse events; a numerical imbalance in preterm birth remains under surveillance and underlies the precautionary gestational window. Maternal vaccination and long-acting monoclonal antibodies (nirsevimab) are best regarded as complementary rather than competing strategies. Current evidence supports maternal immunization as one of the most effective measures to reduce the burden of RSV disease in early infancy.

papers.abstract_zh: 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 是小婴儿严重下呼吸道感染的主要原因,在全世界范围内造成大量发病、住院和死亡,其中最高负担集中在生命的最初几个月,此时免疫和解剖学不成熟有利于严重疾病。孕产妇疫苗接种已成为一种通过中和抗体经胎盘转移来弥补这一脆弱窗口的策略。这篇综合综述综合了 2022 年至 2026 年期间发表的科学文章,包括系统综述、荟萃分析、叙述性综述以及来自国家和国际科学学会的立场声明,讨论了孕产妇 RSV 免疫的流行病学、临床表现、诊断、作用机制、功效、安全性和公共卫生影响。二价预融合 F 蛋白疫苗(RSVpreF;Abrysvo®)在妊娠 32 至 36 周期间以单次肌肉注射剂量施用,可诱导母体 IgG 转移至胎儿,并在生命的前六个月内提供被动保护。在 MATISSE 3 期试验中,疫苗接种在出生后 90 天内对严重 RSV 下呼吸道感染的功效为 81.8%,在 180 天内为 69.4%,同时减少了住院治疗。安全性良好,主要是轻微和短暂的不良事件;早产数量的不平衡仍在监测之中,也是预防性妊娠窗口的基础。母亲疫苗接种和长效单克隆抗体(nirsevimab)最好被视为互补而非竞争策略。目前的证据支持孕产妇免疫接种是减轻婴儿早期 RSV 疾病负担的最有效措施之一。

papers.title: Screening and mechanism analysis of core target genes for resveratrol inhibiting respiratory syncytial virus.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), a single-stranded negative-sense RNA virus, is a major pathogen of acute respiratory tract infections, posing severe threats to the health of infants, the elderly and immunocompromised individuals. While approved vaccines for older adults and monoclonal antibody prophylaxis for infants are available, effective therapeutic drugs remain scarce. Resveratrol, a phenolic compound naturally present in grapes, berries and other foods, has been confirmed to exhibit anti-RSV activity, but its molecular mechanism of action remains unclear. OBJECTIVES: This study aimed to screen the core targets and key signaling pathways of resveratrol against RSV using computational biology approaches, propose testable research hypotheses and provide a theoretical basis for subsequent experimental validation. METHODS: A total of 261 resveratrol-related targets and 1196 RSV-related targets were retrieved from databases. Venny 2.1.0 was used to identify 67 overlapping targets, which were then subjected to protein-protein interaction (PPI) network construction via STRING/Cytoscape and topological analysis for core target screening. GO/KEGG enrichment analyses were performed using the DAVID database and molecular docking validation was conducted with PyMOL/AutoDock. RESULTS: Ten core targets including EGFR, SRC, HSP90AA1 and ALB were identified. GO enrichment focused on biological processes such as PI3K-Akt signal transduction and MAPK cascade regulation, while KEGG pathways were enriched in the Ras signaling pathway and others. Molecular docking showed stable binding of resveratrol to core targets, with all binding energies <-5 kcal/mol. CONCLUSION: This in-silico study predicts that resveratrol may exert anti-RSV effects by targeting host proteins such as EGFR and SRC and regulating key pathways including PI3K-Akt and Ras, complementing existing evidence of its direct interaction with viral proteins. The study provides novel insights for anti-RSV drug development and a theoretical foundation for subsequent experimental validation.

analysis.summary_en: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is a significant pathogen causing acute respiratory infections, particularly in vulnerable populations, with limited therapeutic options available. This study aimed to elucidate the molecular mechanisms of resveratrol's anti-RSV activity using computational biology approaches. papers.title: Burden of respiratory syncytial virus in spinal muscular atrophy: a retrospective nationwide cross-sectional and birth cohort study
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) is a severe neuromuscular disease associated with a high risk of respiratory complications, yet real-world data on respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infection in this population remain limited. This study aimed to investigate the severity, hospitalization costs, and seasonal patterns of RSV infections in patients with SMA using real-world data in Taiwan. METHODS: This retrospective study analyzed data from Taiwan's National Health Insurance Research Database from 2009 to 2021. Patients with SMA were identified through at least two outpatient clinic visits and one hospital admission. The analysis included a cross-sectional study and a birth cohort analysis for sensitivity testing. RSV-associated hospitalizations were identified using diagnostic codes for RSV. The main outcomes included ICU admissions, ventilator use, hospitalization costs, timing of RSV onset, and seasonal infection trends. RESULTS: This study documented 914 hospitalizations in patients with SMA over 13 years, including 14 RSV infections (1.5%). All RSV-related hospitalizations were documented before age 18. In a birth cohort analysis comparing 110 patients with SMA to 2,103,997 individuals from the general population, patients with SMA demonstrated significantly higher RSV hospitalization rates (9.8% vs. 1.6%), ICU admissions (54.5% vs. 4.7%; p < 0.0001), and ventilator use (54.5% vs. 1.7%; p < 0.0001), with a later mean onset (2.54 ± 2.05 years vs. 1.05 ± 1.05 years; p = 0.0073) and substantially higher hospitalization costs (median 967 [560-6,462] USD vs. 683 [487-1002] USD; p = 0.0480). Infections peaked in fall and winter (72.7%) for patients with SMA. ICU admission rates for RSV increased with age and decreased with later SMA onset. CONCLUSIONS: Patients with SMA are at heightened risk for severe RSV infections even beyond infancy, underscoring the need for age-specific and seasonal prevention strategies, particularly for those over two years old.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:脊髓性肌萎缩症(SMA)是一种严重的神经肌肉疾病,与呼吸道并发症的高风险相关,但该人群中呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)感染的真实数据仍然有限。本研究旨在利用台湾的真实数据调查 SMA 患者 RSV 感染的严重程度、住院费用和季节性模式。方法:这项回顾性研究分析了 2009 年至 2021 年台湾国民健康保险研究数据库的数据。通过至少两次门诊就诊和一次入院来识别 SMA 患者。该分析包括一项横断面研究和用于敏感性测试的出生队列分析。使用 RSV 诊断代码来识别与 RSV 相关的住院治疗。主要结果包括 ICU 入院情况、呼吸机使用情况、住院费用、RSV 发病时间和季节性感染趋势。结果:这项研究记录了 914 例 SMA 患者住院治疗超过 13 年的情况,其中 14 例 RSV 感染 (1.5%)。所有与 RSV 相关的住院治疗均在 18 岁之前记录。在一项将 110 名 SMA 患者与普通人群中的 2,103,997 名患者进行比较的出生队列分析中,SMA 患者表现出明显更高的 RSV 住院率(9.8% vs. 1.6%)、ICU 入院率(54.5% vs. 4.7%;p < 0.0001)和呼吸机使用率(54.5% vs. 1.6%)。1.7%;p < 0.0001),平均发病时间较晚(2.54 ± 2.05 年 vs. 1.05 ± 1.05 年;p = 0.0073),住院费用显着较高(中位数 967 [560-6,462] 美元 vs. 683 [487-1002] 美元;p = 0.0480)。SMA 患者的感染高峰期为秋季和冬季(72.7%)。RSV 入住 ICU 的比率随着年龄的增长而增加,并随着 SMA 发病的后期而降低。结论:SMA 患者即使在婴儿期之后也面临着严重 RSV 感染的较高风险,这强调了针对年龄和季节性预防策略的必要性,特别是对于两岁以上的患者。

papers.title: Modulation of Respiratory Diseases by the Endocannabinoid System: A Therapeutic Perspective.
papers.abstract: Respiratory system diseases represent a major global health burden, characterized by high prevalence and significant morbidity and mortality. The respiratory tract's direct and continuous exposure to the external environment makes it particularly vulnerable to pathogens, pollutants and other injurious agents. This exposure often triggers excessive inflammatory responses and compromises the integrity of the air-blood barrier, leading to impaired gas exchange, hypoxia and respiratory failure. Therefore, modulating pulmonary inflammation and enhancing barrier function are critical therapeutic objectives. The endocannabinoid system, a ubiquitous signalling network comprising cannabinoid receptors, endogenous ligands and metabolic enzymes, has emerged as a crucial modulator of these processes. This review summarizes the role of the ECS in major respiratory diseases, including asthma, pulmonary fibrosis, respiratory syncytial virus infection and acute lung injury. The evidence highlights the therapeutic potential of targeting the ECS through strategies such as receptor-specific ligands and inhibitors of endocannabinoid-degrading enzymes. However, the context-dependent nature of ECS modulation necessitates precise intervention. Future efforts should focus on developing selective therapeutics and validating their efficacy in clinical settings, positioning the ECS as a sophisticated target for innovative respiratory disease management.

papers.abstract_zh: 呼吸系统疾病是全球主要的健康负担,其特点是患病率高、发病率和死亡率高。呼吸道直接且持续地暴露于外部环境,使其特别容易受到病原体、污染物和其他有害物质的侵害。这种暴露通常会引发过度的炎症反应,损害气血屏障的完整性,导致气体交换受损、缺氧和呼吸衰竭。因此,调节肺部炎症和增强屏障功能是关键的治疗目标。内源性大麻素系统是一种普遍存在的信号网络,由大麻素受体、内源性配体和代谢酶组成,已成为这些过程的关键调节剂。本综述总结了 ECS 在主要呼吸系统疾病中的作用,包括哮喘、肺纤维化、呼吸道合胞病毒感染和急性肺损伤。证据强调了通过受体特异性配体和内源性大麻素降解酶抑制剂等策略靶向 ECS 的治疗潜力。然而,ECS 调制的上下文相关性质需要精确的干预。未来的努力应集中于开发选择性疗法并在临床环境中验证其疗效,将 ECS 定位为创新呼吸系统疾病管理的复杂目标。

papers.title: The Resurgence of Respiratory Viruses After COVID-19: Molecular Insights from Pediatric SARI in Kashmir.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Respiratory viruses are major contributors to severe acute respiratory infections (SARI) in children. Data on their molecular epidemiology in northern India remains limited, particularly in the post-COVID-19 period. This study aimed to determine the prevalence and distribution of respiratory viral pathogens among hospitalized pediatric SARI patients in Kashmir. METHODS: A prospective study was conducted from October 2023 to April 2025 at Sher-i-Kashmir Institute of Medical Sciences, Srinagar. Children aged ≤15 years meeting the World Health Organization SARI case definition were enrolled. Nasopharyngeal and/or oropharyngeal samples were collected and tested using real-time polymerase chain reaction assays for SARS-CoV-2, Influenza A and B, Respiratory Syncytial virus (RSV) A and B, Adenovirus, Human metapneumovirus, Rhinovirus, and Para-influenza viruses. RESULTS: A total of 326 pediatric SARI cases were included. At least one respiratory virus was detected in 200 patients (61.3%). RSV was the most frequently detected virus, with RSV-B identified in 111 cases (34.0%) and RSV-A in 26 cases (7.9%). Influenza viruses accounted for a smaller proportion, including influenza A(H1N1) in 12 cases (3.6%), influenza A(H3N2) in 6 cases (1.8%), and influenza B (Victoria lineage) in 21 cases (6.4%). Other viruses detected included Adenovirus, Para-influenza virus, Rhinovirus, and Human metapneumovirus. Most infections occurred during winter months and predominantly affected infants. CONCLUSION: Respiratory viruses account for a substantial proportion of pediatric SARI cases in Kashmir, with RSV emerging as the predominant pathogen in the post-pandemic period. Strengthening molecular surveillance may improve diagnostic stewardship and guide targeted prevention strategies.

papers.title_zh: COVID-19 后呼吸道病毒的死灰复燃:来自克什米尔儿科 SARI 的分子见解。
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Respiratory viruses are major contributors to severe acute respiratory infections (SARI) in children. Data on their molecular epidemiology in northern India remains limited, particularly in the post-COVID-19 period. This study aimed to determine the prevalence and distribution of respiratory viral pathogens among hospitalized pediatric SARI patients in Kashmir. METHODS: A prospective study was conducted from October 2023 to April 2025 at Sher-i-Kashmir Institute of Medical Sciences, Srinagar. Children aged ≤15 years meeting the World Health Organization SARI case definition were enrolled. Nasopharyngeal and/or oropharyngeal samples were collected and tested using real-time polymerase chain reaction assays for SARS-CoV-2, Influenza A and B, Respiratory Syncytial virus (RSV) A and B, Adenovirus, Human metapneumovirus, Rhinovirus, and Para-influenza viruses. RESULTS: A total of 326 pediatric SARI cases were included. At least one respiratory virus was detected in 200 patients (61.3%). RSV was the most frequently detected virus, with RSV-B identified in 111 cases (34.0%) and RSV-A in 26 cases (7.9%). Influenza viruses accounted for a smaller proportion, including influenza A(H1N1) in 12 cases (3.6%), influenza A(H3N2) in 6 cases (1.8%), and influenza B (Victoria lineage) in 21 cases (6.4%). Other viruses detected included Adenovirus, Para-influenza virus, Rhinovirus, and Human metapneumovirus. Most infections occurred during winter months and predominantly affected infants. CONCLUSION: Respiratory viruses account for a substantial proportion of pediatric SARI cases in Kashmir, with RSV emerging as the predominant pathogen in the post-pandemic period. Strengthening molecular surveillance may improve diagnostic stewardship and guide targeted prevention strategies.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:呼吸道病毒是儿童严重急性呼吸道感染(SARI)的主要原因。印度北部的分子流行病学数据仍然有限,特别是在后 COVID-19 时期。本研究旨在确定克什米尔住院儿童 SARI 患者中呼吸道病毒病原体的患病率和分布。方法:2023 年 10 月至 2025 年 4 月在斯利那加谢尔克什米尔医学科学研究所进行了一项前瞻性研究。纳入符合世界卫生组织SARI病例定义的年龄≤15岁的儿童。收集鼻咽和/或口咽样本,并使用实时聚合酶链反应检测 SARS-CoV-2、甲型和乙型流感、呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) A 和 B、腺病毒、人类偏肺病毒、鼻病毒和副流感病毒。结果:共纳入 326 例儿童 SARI 病例。200 名患者(61.3%)中至少检测到一种呼吸道病毒。RSV 是最常检测到的病毒,其中 RSV-B 在 111 例(34.0%)中检出,RSV-A 在 26 例(7.9%)中检出。流感病毒所占比例较小,其中甲型H1N1流感12例(3.6%),甲型H3N2流感6例(1.8%),乙型流感(维多利亚系)21例(6.4%)。检测到的其他病毒包括腺病毒、副流感病毒、鼻病毒和人类偏肺病毒。大多数感染发生在冬季,主要影响婴儿。结论:克什米尔儿童 SARI 病例中呼吸道病毒占很大比例,RSV 成为大流行后时期的主要病原体。加强分子监测可以改善诊断管理并指导有针对性的预防策略。

papers.title: Infant respiratory syncytial virus and childhood asthma: a nationwide phenotyping, sibling-controlled, and genome-wide association study
papers.abstract: Background: Early-life respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infection is associated with childhood recurrent wheeze or asthma (RW/A), but causality and shared genetic liability remain unclear. Methods We combined Finnish nationwide registries and Nordic genetic cohorts. First, in 965 312 Finnish children born between 1998 and 2014, we defined severe RSV as RSV hospitalisation before age 1 year, and recurrent wheezing or asthma (RW/A) as inhaled medication reimbursement between ages 1 and 7 years, and compared medication and eosinophil trajectories by RSV history. Second, we assessed familial confounding in 527 776 full siblings and 15 667 RW/A-discordant pairs. Third, we performed a genome-wide association study (GWAS) of RSV susceptibility with meta-analysis across six Nordic cohorts (3 107 cases, 92 031 controls) and two-sample Mendelian randomisation (2SMR) using 155 asthma-associated variants. Findings RSV-associated RW/A showed higher inhaled medication use at ages 1-2 years but lower use after age 4, and lower mean blood eosinophils (0.34 vs 0.39*10e9/L; p=0.003) than RW/A without RSV hospitalisation. In RW/A-discordant sibling pairs, RSV hospitalisation was associated with RW/A (OR 2.8; 95% CI 2.4-3.2), while unaffected siblings also had elevated RW/A prevalence. GWAS identified an RSV association at APBB1IP (rs787036; beta=0.209; p=8.80*10e-9). 2SMR provided no evidence that asthma genetic liability influenced RSV susceptibility. Interpretation The RSV-asthma association is unlikely to be explained by shared genetic or environmental factors, and RSV-associated RW/A shows a distinct trajectory. These findings help prioritise long-term outcomes for RSV prevention trials and monitoring. Funding: Paivikki and Sakari Sohlberg Foundation, Foundation for Pediatric Research, Sigrid Juselius Foundation, Orion Research Foundation, the Research Council of Norway.

source_records.title: Infant respiratory syncytial virus and childhood asthma: a nationwide phenotyping, sibling-controlled, and genome-wide association study
source_records.abstract: Background Early-life respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infection is associated with childhood recurrent wheeze or asthma (RW/A), but causality and shared genetic liability remain unclear. Methods We combined Finnish nationwide registries and Nordic genetic cohorts. First, in 965 312 Finnish children born between 1998 and 2014, we defined severe RSV as RSV hospitalisation before age 1 year, and recurrent wheezing or asthma (RW/A) as inhaled medication reimbursement between ages 1 and 7 years, and compared medication and eosinophil trajectories by RSV history. Second, we assessed familial confounding in 527 776 full siblings and 15 667 RW/A-discordant pairs. Third, we performed a genome-wide association study (GWAS) of RSV susceptibility with meta-analysis across six Nordic cohorts (3 107 cases, 92 031 controls) and two-sample Mendelian randomisation (2SMR) using 155 asthma-associated variants. GWAS identified an RSV association at APBB1IP (rs787036; beta=0.209; p=8.80*10e-9). 2SMR provided no evidence that asthma genetic liability influenced RSV susceptibility. Interpretation The RSV-asthma association is unlikely to be explained by shared genetic or environmental factors, and RSV-associated RW/A shows a distinct trajectory. These findings help prioritise long-term outcomes for RSV prevention trials and monitoring. Funding: Paivikki and Sakari Sohlberg Foundation, Foundation for Pediatric Research, Sigrid Juselius Foundation, Orion Research Foundation, the Research Council of Norway.

analysis.summary_en: This review evaluates the causal link between early-life RSV infection and childhood asthma using nationwide Finnish and Nordic cohorts. It finds that RSV-associated asthma shows a distinct trajectory with higher early medication use but lower eosinophil levels and a GWAS signal at APBB1IP, while sibling analyses suggest familial confounding. papers.abstract_zh: 背景:生命早期呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)感染与儿童反复喘息或哮喘(RW/A)有关,但因果关系和共同的遗传倾向仍不清楚。方法 我们将芬兰全国登记处和北欧遗传队列结合起来。首先,在 1998 年至 2014 年间出生的 965 312 名芬兰儿童中,我们将严重 RSV 定义为 1 岁之前因 RSV 住院治疗,将反复喘息或哮喘 (RW/A) 定义为 1 岁至 7 岁之间的吸入药物报销,并根据 RSV 病史比较药物和嗜酸性粒细胞轨迹。其次,我们评估了 527 776 名同胞兄弟姐妹和 15 667 对 RW/A 不一致的家庭混杂因素。第三,我们进行了 RSV 易感性全基因组关联研究 (GWAS),对 6 个北欧队列(3 107 例病例,92 031 名对照)进行了荟萃分析,并使用 155 个哮喘相关变异进行了两样本孟德尔随机化 (2SMR)。结果发现,与没有 RSV 住院的 RW/A 相比,RSV 相关的 RW/A 在 1-2 岁时吸入药物使用量较高,但在 4 岁后使用量较低,并且平均血液嗜酸性粒细胞较低(0.34 vs 0.39*10e9/L;p=0.003)。在 RW/A 不一致的兄弟姐妹中,RSV 住院与 RW/A 相关(OR 2.8;95% CI 2.4-3.2),而未受影响的兄弟姐妹的 RW/A 患病率也较高。GWAS 在 APBB1IP 上发现了 RSV 关联(rs787036;beta=0.209;p=8.80*10e-9)。2SMR 没有提供证据表明哮喘遗传倾向影响 RSV 易感性。解释 RSV-哮喘关联不太可能用共同的遗传或环境因素来解释,RSV 相关的 RW/A 显示出独特的轨迹。这些发现有助于优先考虑 RSV 预防试验和监测的长期结果。资助:Paivikki 和 Sakari Sohlberg 基金会、儿科研究基金会、Sigrid Juselius 基金会、猎户座研究基金会、挪威研究委员会。

papers.title: Clinical and population genomic epidemiology of invasive group A streptococcus in Scotland, 2014-2024
papers.abstract: ObjectivesFollowing the COVID-19 pandemic, multiple countries reported a surge in invasive group A streptococcus (iGAS) infections. Posited explanations include reduced population immunity, increased respiratory virus co-infection, and emergence of hypervirulent GAS clones. To assess the relative contribution of these factors, we analyzed the epidemiology and genomics of 3,408 iGAS infections in Scotland. MethodsNational surveillance data from 2014-2024 were analyzed to characterize iGAS incidence. Hybrid whole genome sequencing was used to comprehensively genetically characterize 404 emm1 isolates collected from invasive and tonsillitis infections. ResultsiGAS incidence markedly increased in late 2022 and early 2023, disproportionately affecting children and older adults. This surge was not associated with a proportional increase in bacteremia but did coincide with increased influenza and respiratory syncytial virus infections. Genomic analyses found that emm1 post-pandemic isolates were not genetically distinct from pre-pandemic isolates in genome-wide polymorphisms, accessory genes including virulence and antimicrobial resistance determinants, mobile genetic elements, or chromosomal structural variants. ConclusionsThe post-pandemic iGAS surge in Scotland was not associated with emergence of a novel hypervirulent emm1 clone. Instead, the epidemiologic and population genomic findings are consistent with increased host susceptibility following reduced pathogen exposure during the pandemic and increased respiratory virus co-infection as predominant contributing factors. papers.abstract_zh: 目标 COVID-19 大流行后,多个国家报告侵袭性 A 族链球菌 (iGAS) 感染激增。提出的解释包括群体免疫力下降、呼吸道病毒合并感染增加以及高毒力 GAS 克隆的出现。为了评估这些因素的相对贡献,我们分析了苏格兰 3,408 例 iGAS 感染的流行病学和基因组学。方法分析 2014-2024 年全国监测数据以表征 iGAS 发病率。使用混合全基因组测序对从侵袭性和扁桃体炎感染中收集的 404 个 emm1 分离株进行了全面的遗传表征。结果 2022 年末和 2023 年初,iGAS 发病率显着增加,对儿童和老年人的影响尤为严重。这种激增与菌血症的比例增加无关,但确实与流感和呼吸道合胞病毒感染的增加相一致。基因组分析发现,emm1 大流行后分离株在全基因组多态性、包括毒力和抗菌素耐药性决定因素在内的辅助基因、移动遗传元件或染色体结构变异方面与大流行前分离株在遗传上没有区别。结论 苏格兰大流行后 iGAS 激增与新型高毒力 emm1 克隆的出现无关。相反,流行病学和群体基因组研究结果与大流行期间病原体暴露减少和呼吸道病毒合并感染增加作为主要影响因素后宿主易感性增加是一致的。要点O_LICOVID-19 后 iGAS 激增对儿童和老年人造成不成比例的影响 C_LIO_LI iGAS 激增与菌血症总体下降几率相关 C_LIO_LI 流感和 RSV 活动峰值与大流行后 iGAS 激增一致 C_LIO_LIEmm1 是最常见的 emm 类型,占 iGAS 激增分离株的 56% C_LIO_LI基因组分析不支持毒性更强的 emm1 克隆的出现 C_LI

papers.title: Respiratory syncytial virus inhibits type I interferon signaling to maintain HLA-DM expression in CD1c+ dendritic cells
papers.abstract: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infection often elicits ineffective long-term immune responses due to inefficient immune priming, complicating disease management and vaccine development. Dendritic cells (DCs) are central regulators of antiviral immunity and antigen presentation; yet, the direct impact of RSV on these pathways remains poorly understood. In this study, we identify sustained HLA-DM expression as a unique hallmark of RSV infected CD1c + DCs, a phenotype not observed following influenza infection or poly(I:C) stimulation. Using single cell RNA sequencing, pharmacological inhibition, and complementary controls, we demonstrate that TBK1 dependent Type I Interferon signaling is a key regulator of HLA-DM expression during DC maturation. Co-culture experiments further suggest that HLA-DM-high DCs influence CD4 + T cell differentiation, supporting a model in which sustained HLA-DM expression reshapes antigen presentation and downstream adaptive immunity. Together, these findings uncover a previously unknown link between innate antiviral signaling and antigen presentation machinery in human DCs.

papers.title_zh: 呼吸道合胞病毒抑制 I 型干扰素信号传导以维持 CD1c+ 树突状细胞中的 HLA-DM 表达
papers.source_body_en: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infection often elicits ineffective long-term immune responses due to inefficient immune priming, complicating disease management and vaccine development. Dendritic cells (DCs) are central regulators of antiviral immunity and antigen presentation; yet, the direct impact of RSV on these pathways remains poorly understood. In this study, we identify sustained HLA-DM expression as a unique hallmark of RSV infected CD1c + DCs, a phenotype not observed following influenza infection or poly(I:C) stimulation. Using single cell RNA sequencing, pharmacological inhibition, and complementary controls, we demonstrate that TBK1 dependent Type I Interferon signaling is a key regulator of HLA-DM expression during DC maturation. Co-culture experiments further suggest that HLA-DM-high DCs influence CD4 + T cell differentiation, supporting a model in which sustained HLA-DM expression reshapes antigen presentation and downstream adaptive immunity. Together, these findings uncover a previously unknown link between innate antiviral signaling and antigen presentation machinery in human DCs.
papers.abstract_zh: 由于免疫启动效率低下,呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)感染常常引起无效的长期免疫反应,使疾病管理和疫苗开发变得复杂。树突状细胞(DC)是抗病毒免疫和抗原呈递的中央调节者;然而,RSV 对这些途径的直接影响仍然知之甚少。在这项研究中,我们将持续的 HLA-DM 表达确定为 RSV 感染的 CD1c + DC 的独特标志,这是流感感染或 Poly(I:C) 刺激后未观察到的表型。通过单细胞 RNA 测序、药理学抑制和互补对照,我们证明 TBK1 依赖性 I 型干扰素信号传导是 DC 成熟过程中 HLA-DM 表达的关键调节因子。共培养实验进一步表明 HLA-DM 高 DC 影响 CD4 + T 细胞分化,支持持续的 HLA-DM 表达重塑抗原呈递和下游适应性免疫的模型。总之,这些发现揭示了人类 DC 中先天抗病毒信号传导和抗原呈递机制之间以前未知的联系。

papers.title: An evaluation of the anti-human respiratory syncytial virus activity of sophora alkaloids and the enhanced efficacy by liposomes via intratracheal administration
papers.abstract: Human respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is a major cause of severe lower respiratory tract infections and related deaths in infants, young children, and the elderly. The clinical management of RSV is challenging due to its high mutation rate and the limited efficacy and safety of existing antiviral drugs. Sophora alkaloids, natural compounds derived from Sophora flavescens, exhibit broad-spectrum antiviral and immunomodulatory activities. Mechanistically, RSV relies on ERK1/2 phosphorylation to facilitate viral replication and spread, while sophora alkaloids inhibit ERK1/2 phosphorylation via regulating MEK/ERK signaling pathway, thereby suppressing viral proliferation and the inflammatory response caused by RSV infection. In vivo studies demonstrated that sophora alkaloids significantly reduced the mortality of RSV-infected mice via intratracheal administration. To further enhance the pulmonary retention of drugs, liposomes were used to improve the therapeutic effects of sophora alkaloids. As the most effective sophora alkaloids against RSV infection, sophocarpine (SC) was encapsulated in liposomes to enhance its anti-RSV infection effect. In vivo studies demonstrate that SC-loaded liposomes outperformed the free SC in suppressing RSV replication and alleviating pulmonary inflammation in murine models of RSV infection. This study not only clarifies the mechanism by which sophora alkaloids counteract RSV-infection but also provides liposomal formulation of SC to improve the anti-RSV therapeutic effects.

papers.title: Epidemiological characteristics of respiratory syncytial virus in children during 2021–2024
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Since the autumn of 2023, there has been a notable increase in the incidence of respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infection among children. This study aimed to demonstrate epidemiology characteristics of RSV during and after the implementation of NPIs and to characterize the seasonal patterns of RSV following the implementation of NPIs. METHODS: This hospital-based retrospective observational study was conducted at Henan Children's Hospital. Demographic information (including gender, age, address), RSV laboratory test results, clinical severity of inpatients and outpatients enrolled during 2021-2024 were extracted from electronic medical records of the hospital. The Chi-square test was used to compare the characteristics of RSV infection. RESULTS: A total of 133156 patients included in the study and 7585 of them were positive in RSV test, Throughout the whole study years, the differences in the distribution of positive rates among different years were statistically significant (χ2= 1860.490, p < 0.001). The positive rate in 2023 was the highest (9.09%), and that in 2021 was the lowest (2.17%). From January 2021 to March 2023, the positivity rate showed a downward trend, and it began to rise in April 2023, sharply increasing in November and reaching its peak in December. From April 2024 until December, the infection rate remained at a low level. However, it increased again in December. There were differences in the positivity rates among different seasons, and these differences were statistically significant (χ2 = 4112.179,p < 0.001). During the period from 2021 to 2024, the positive rate in winter was higher than that in other seasons. The positive rates for males were higher than that for females, and the differences were statistically significant (χ2= 49.678, p < 0.001). There were differences in the distribution of RSV positive rates among different age groups, and these differences were statistically significant (χ2= 863.334, p < 0.001). In 2021 and 2022, the positive rate of RSV was the highest in the 3-6 years old group, which was 3.24% and 3.49% respectively; in 2023 and 2024, the positive rate of RSV was the highest in the 0-1 years old group, which was 15.29% and 14.05% respectively. CONCLUSION: No change in the infection patterns was observed, the RSV positive rate still peaks in winter. since 2023, there has been a trend of RSV infections shifting toward younger children. It is essential for clinicians to prioritize the prevention of RSV infection in infants.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:自2023年秋季以来,儿童呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)感染发病率显着上升。本研究旨在证明 NPI 实施期间和实施后 RSV 的流行病学特征,并描述 NPI 实施后 RSV 的季节性模式。方法:这项以医院为基础的回顾性观察研究在河南省儿童医院进行。从医院的电子病历中提取2021-2024年入组的住院患者和门诊患者的人口统计信息(包括性别、年龄、地址)、RSV实验室检测结果、临床严重程度。采用卡方检验比较RSV感染特征。结果:本研究共纳入133156例患者,其中RSV检测阳性7585例,纵观整个研究年份,不同年份之间阳性率分布差异有统计学意义(χ2=1860.490,p<0.001)。2023年阳性率最高(9.09%),2021年阳性率最低(2.17%)。2021年1月至2023年3月,阳性率呈下降趋势,2023年4月开始上升,11月大幅上升,12月达到峰值。2024年4月至12月,感染率保持在较低水平。然而,12 月份再次增加。不同季节阳性率存在差异,且差异有统计学意义(χ2 = 4112.179,p < 0.001)。2021年至2024年期间,冬季阳性率高于其他季节。男性阳性率高于女性,差异有统计学意义(χ2=49.678,p<0.001)。不同年龄组间RSV阳性率分布存在差异,且差异有统计学意义(χ2=863.334,p<0.001)。2021年和2022年,3-6岁组RSV阳性率最高,分别为3.24%和3.49%;2023年和2024年,0-1岁组RSV阳性率最高,分别为15.29%和14.05%。结论:感染模式未见变化,RSV阳性率仍以冬季为高峰。自2023年以来,RSV感染有向年龄较小的儿童转移的趋势。临床医生必须优先考虑预防婴儿 RSV 感染。

papers.title: NonPharmaceutical Interventions and PostPandemic Resurgence: The Shifting Epidemiology of Influenza, Respiratory Syncytial Virus, and Adenovirus in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province (2020-2024)
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Acute respiratory infections (ARIs) caused by influenza A/B (Flu A/Flu B), respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), and adenovirus (ADV) remain a major global health burden. The COVID-19 pandemic profoundly altered respiratory virus transmission through nonpharmaceutical interventions (NPIs). Methods Samples from patients with respiratory tract infections at Hangzhou Hospital of Traditional Chinese Medicine from January 2020 to October 2024 were collected. ADV, Flu A, Flu B, and RSV were detected to evaluate the impact of NPIs on viral epidemiology. Statistical analyses were performed using SPSS software and GraphPad Prism. Multivariable binary logistic regression models, adjusting for age group and sex, were constructed to evaluate the independent effect of NPI relaxation (strict NPI period 2020-2022 vs. post-relaxation period 2023-2024) on virus positivity. Stratified analyses by age group and demographic comparability assessments between periods were also performed. Results Overall virus positivity declined from 27.4% (2020) to 14.5% (2021) during strict NPIs, then rebounded to 35.1% in 2023 after relaxation. Flu A resurged atypically in summer 2022 and dominated the 2023 winter peak, while Flu B increased annually and peaked in 2024. ADV regained its prepandemic summer seasonality by 2024, whereas RSV showed limited seasonal variation. Higher ADV positivity was observed in males, and higher Flu B positivity in females. By 2024, influenza burden shifted toward adults and geriatric populations, while children under five remained most vulnerable to RSV and ADV. However, after adjusting for demographic shifts—including a significant increase in adult patients (18-60 years: 22.1% to 40.0%) and altered sex ratios between periods (both P 0.05). Stratified analyses further revealed that the magnitude of period-related risk reduction increased with age for all pathogens. Conclusion This study demonstrates that the postpandemic resurgence of respiratory viruses in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, was not a monolithic recrudescence following NPIs relaxation, but a multifaceted shifting epidemiology driven by three convergent forces: expanded school-based and community screening that broadened the tested denominator, demographic case-mix shifts toward higher-risk adult populations, and pathogen-specific alterations in seasonal and age-specific transmission patterns. The consistently lower adjusted odds of positivity during the post-relaxation period indicate that crude resurgence signals must be interpreted through the lens of surveillance structure.

papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background Acute respiratory infections (ARIs) caused by influenza A/B (Flu A/Flu B), respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), and adenovirus (ADV) remain a major global health burden. The COVID-19 pandemic profoundly altered respiratory virus transmission through nonpharmaceutical interventions (NPIs). Methods Samples from patients with respiratory tract infections at Hangzhou Hospital of Traditional Chinese Medicine from January 2020 to October 2024 were collected. ADV, Flu A, Flu B, and RSV were detected to evaluate the impact of NPIs on viral epidemiology. Statistical analyses were performed using SPSS software and GraphPad Prism. Multivariable binary logistic regression models, adjusting for age group and sex, were constructed to evaluate the independent effect of NPI relaxation (strict NPI period 2020-2022 vs. post-relaxation period 2023-2024) on virus positivity. Stratified analyses by age group and demographic comparability assessments between periods were also performed. Results Overall virus positivity declined from 27.4% (2020) to 14.5% (2021) during strict NPIs, then rebounded to 35.1% in 2023 after relaxation. Flu A resurged atypically in summer 2022 and dominated the 2023 winter peak, while Flu B increased annually and peaked in 2024. ADV regained its prepandemic summer seasonality by 2024, whereas RSV showed limited seasonal variation. Higher ADV positivity was observed in males, and higher Flu B positivity in females. By 2024, influenza burden shifted toward adults and geriatric populations, while children under five remained most vulnerable to RSV and ADV. However, after adjusting for demographic shifts—including a significant increase in adult patients (18-60 years: 22.1% to 40.0%) and altered sex ratios between periods (both P 0.05). Stratified analyses further revealed that the magnitude of period-related risk reduction increased with age for all pathogens. Conclusion This study demonstrates that the postpandemic resurgence of respiratory viruses in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, was not a monolithic recrudescence following NPIs relaxation, but a multifaceted shifting epidemiology driven by three convergent forces: expanded school-based and community screening that broadened the tested denominator, demographic case-mix shifts toward higher-risk adult populations, and pathogen-specific alterations in seasonal and age-specific transmission patterns. The consistently lower adjusted odds of positivity during the post-relaxation period indicate that crude resurgence signals must be interpreted through the lens of surveillance structure.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要背景 由甲型/乙型流感(Flu A/Flu B)、呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)和腺病毒(ADV)引起的急性呼吸道感染(ARIs)仍然是全球主要的健康负担。COVID-19 大流行通过非药物干预措施 (NPI) 深刻改变了呼吸道病毒的传播。方法收集2020年1月至2024年10月杭州市中医院收治的呼吸道感染患者标本。检测 ADV、A 型流感、B 型流感和 RSV,以评估 NPI 对病毒流行病学的影响。使用SPSS软件和GraphPad Prism进行统计分析。构建了调整年龄组和性别的多变量二元逻辑回归模型,以评估 NPI 放宽(2020-2022 年严格 NPI 期与 2023-2024 年放宽后期)对病毒阳性的独立影响。还进行了按年龄组的分层分析和不同时期之间的人口可比性评估。结果 在严格的 NPI 期间,总体病毒阳性率从 27.4%(2020 年)下降至 14.5%(2021 年),然后在放松后于 2023 年反弹至 35.1%。A 型流感在 2022 年夏季非典型地卷土重来,并主导了 2023 年冬季高峰,而 B 型流感则逐年增加,并于 2024 年达到高峰。ADV 到 2024 年恢复了大流行前的夏季季节性,而 RSV 则表现出有限的季节性变化。男性中 ADV 阳性率较高,女性中 B 型流感阳性率较高。到 2024 年,流感负担转向成人和老年人群,而五岁以下儿童仍然最容易感染 RSV 和 ADV。然而,在对人口统计变化进行调整后,包括成年患者的显着增加(18-60 岁:22.1% 至 40.0%)以及不同时期之间性别比例的变化(均 P < 0.05)。分层分析进一步显示,对于所有病原体来说,与经期相关的风险降低幅度随着年龄的增长而增加。结论 本研究表明,浙江省杭州市大流行后呼吸道病毒的复苏并不是 NPI 放松后的整体复发,而是由三种汇聚力量驱动的流行病学的多方面转变:扩大学校和社区筛查范围以扩大检测分母,人口病例组合向高风险成年人群转变,以及季节性和特定年龄传播模式的病原体特异性改变。在放松后时期,调整后的阳性几率持续较低,这表明必须通过监视结构的视角来解释粗略的复苏信号。

papers.title: How Pandemics Have Reshaped the Respiratory Virus Data Landscape in Europe: Scoping Review
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Acute respiratory infections caused by influenza, respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), and SARS-CoV-2 remain a major public health challenge in Europe. Although surveillance systems for these pathogens are well established, the past 2 decades have seen a rapid diversification of data streams supporting surveillance and research. This expanding data landscape, combined with fragmentation across institutions, sectors, and countries, may limit timely evidence synthesis and effective public health decision-making. Objective This scoping review aimed to identify and characterize data sources used for surveillance and research on influenza, RSV, and SARS-CoV-2 in Europe over the past 20 years, and to examine their evolution over time, their alignment with research objectives, and geographic variation in data availability and use. Methods We conducted a scoping review using an objective-driven analytical framework. Empirical reports published between January 2005 and September 2025 were identified in MEDLINE, Web of Science, and Embase. Eligible reports focused on influenza, RSV, or SARS-CoV-2 and included data from 12 European countries. Clinical and interventional studies were excluded. Reports were classified according to 4 research objectives: epidemiological monitoring, evaluation of interventions, assessment of disease burden and health outcomes, and analyses of population adherence and trust toward public health measures. Data sources were grouped into 9 categories, including surveillance systems, electronic health records (EHRs), registries, claims, surveys, digital, environmental, integrated datasets, and others. Results A total of 2564 empirical reports were included. Over time, respiratory virus research relied on an increasingly diverse set of data streams. While surveillance systems remained central, particularly for epidemiological monitoring, their relative dominance declined. From 2020 onward, there was a marked expansion in the use of EHRs, registries, claims data, digital sources, and linked or integrated datasets, alongside increased use of open-access data. Data source use varied by research objective: surveillance data predominated in monitoring and intervention evaluation; EHRs in studies of risk factors and treatment effectiveness; surveys in seroprevalence and public trust analyses; and claims data in assessments of economic burden. Substantial geographic disparities were observed. Northern European countries more frequently used linked and multisource datasets, whereas Southern Europe relied more often on open-access or single-source data. Conclusions This scoping review provides a multipathogen, cross-country mapping of data sources for respiratory virus surveillance and research in Europe over 2 decades, applying an innovative objective-driven framework. Unlike prior reviews focused on single pathogens or data types, it offers a consolidated, comparative perspective based on 2564 reports to inform public health decision-making. The COVID-19 pandemic accelerated innovation in data generation and access, but progress remained largely centered on SARS-CoV-2, while structural fragmentation continues to limit timely, integrated data across Europe. Strengthening preparedness will require interoperable infrastructures, federated analysis platforms, sustainable funding for surveillance innovations, and cross-sectoral data sharing.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 由流感、呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 和 SARS-CoV-2 引起的急性呼吸道感染仍然是欧洲的主要公共卫生挑战。尽管针对这些病原体的监测系统已经很完善,但在过去的 20 年里,支持监测和研究的数据流迅速多样化。这种不断扩大的数据格局,加上机构、部门和国家之间的碎片化,可能会限制及时的证据综合和有效的公共卫生决策。目的 本次范围界定审查旨在确定和描述过去 20 年来欧洲用于流感、RSV 和 SARS-CoV-2 监测和研究的数据源,并检查其随时间的演变、与研究目标的一致性以及数据可用性和使用的地理差异。方法 我们使用目标驱动的分析框架进行了范围界定审查。MEDLINE、Web of Science 和 Embase 确定了 2005 年 1 月至 2025 年 9 月期间发表的实证报告。符合条件的报告重点关注流感、RSV 或 SARS-CoV-2,并包含来自 12 个欧洲国家的数据。临床和介入研究被排除在外。报告根据 4 个研究目标进行分类:流行病学监测、干预措施评估、疾病负担和健康结果评估,以及人口对公共卫生措施的依从性和信任度分析。数据源分为 9 类,包括监测系统、电子健康记录 (EHR)、登记、索赔、调查、数字、环境、综合数据集等。结果共纳入2564份实证报告。随着时间的推移,呼吸道病毒研究依赖于越来越多样化的数据流。虽然监测系统仍然处于核心地位,特别是流行病学监测,但其相对主导地位有所下降。从 2020 年起,电子病历、登记、索赔数据、数字源以及链接或集成数据集的使用显着扩大,同时开放获取数据的使用也有所增加。数据源的使用因研究目的而异:监测数据在监测和干预评估中占主导地位;危险因素和治疗效果研究中的电子病历;血清流行率调查和公众信任分析;以及经济负担评估中的索赔数据。观察到了巨大的地理差异。北欧国家更频繁地使用链接和多源数据集,而南欧国家更频繁地依赖开放访问或单一来源数据。结论 本次范围界定审查应用创新的目标驱动框架,为欧洲 20 年来呼吸道病毒监测和研究提供了多病原体、跨国数据源图谱。与之前专注于单一病原体或数据类型的审查不同,它提供了基于 2564 份报告的综合比较视角,为公共卫生决策提供信息。COVID-19 大流行加速了数据生成和获取方面的创新,但进展仍然主要集中在 SARS-CoV-2 上,而结构碎片化继续限制整个欧洲及时、整合的数据。加强准备工作需要可互操作的基础设施、联合分析平台、可持续的监测创新资金以及跨部门数据共享。

papers.title: Real-world effectiveness of adjuvanted RSVPreF3 vaccination in the prevention of RSV-related hospitalization among US adults aged ≥60 years.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: There is a growing body of evidence on the real-world effectiveness of adjuvanted respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) prefusion F3 (RSVPreF3) vaccination against RSV-related hospitalization among older adults. However, additional research is needed to further estimate vaccine effectiveness (VE) in subgroups at increased risk for severe RSV disease. RESEARCH QUESTION: What is the VE of adjuvanted RSVPreF3 vaccination against RSV-related hospitalization among adults aged ≥60 years in the United States (US), including subgroups at increased risk for severe RSV disease? STUDY DESIGN AND METHODS: This retrospective cohort study utilized claims data from the Optum Research Database (ORD). Adjuvanted RSVPreF3-vaccinated and unvaccinated adults aged ≥60 years were identified (August 2023-May 2024) and exact matched 1:4 by age, sex, insurance type, and US state. Vaccination date was assigned as the index date. Baseline characteristics were measured during the 12-month pre-index period, with continuous enrollment required, and were balanced using propensity score-based weighting. Individuals were followed from 14 days post-index to the earliest of: disenrollment, death, RSV vaccination, or end of the analysis period (May 31, 2024). Hazard ratios (HRs) were estimated using Cox proportional hazards regression, comparing risk of RSV-related hospitalization, with VE calculated as (1 - HR) x 100%. RESULTS: The study included 520,440 vaccinated and 2,081,760 unvaccinated individuals. Median follow-up was 5.6 months, with a maximum of 9.7 months. Estimated VE was 75.6% (95% confidence interval [CI]: 69.8-80.2%). VE estimates in key subgroups included 72.5% (64.3-78.8%) among those with chronic pulmonary disease, 72.2% (64.1-78.4%) among those with cardiovascular disease, 82.3% (74.2-87.9%) among those with diabetes, and 71.4% (57.0-81.1%) among those who were immunocompromised. INTERPRETATION: These findings highlight the effectiveness of adjuvanted RSVPreF3 vaccination in preventing RSV-related hospitalization among older adults, including those at increased risk, suggesting that vaccination is an effective strategy in reducing RSV disease burden.

papers.title_zh: RSVPreF3 辅助疫苗接种在预防 60 岁以上美国成年人因 RSV 相关住院方面的真实效果。
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: There is a growing body of evidence on the real-world effectiveness of adjuvanted respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) prefusion F3 (RSVPreF3) vaccination against RSV-related hospitalization among older adults. However, additional research is needed to further estimate vaccine effectiveness (VE) in subgroups at increased risk for severe RSV disease. RESEARCH QUESTION: What is the VE of adjuvanted RSVPreF3 vaccination against RSV-related hospitalization among adults aged ≥60 years in the United States (US), including subgroups at increased risk for severe RSV disease? STUDY DESIGN AND METHODS: This retrospective cohort study utilized claims data from the Optum Research Database (ORD). Adjuvanted RSVPreF3-vaccinated and unvaccinated adults aged ≥60 years were identified (August 2023-May 2024) and exact matched 1:4 by age, sex, insurance type, and US state. Vaccination date was assigned as the index date. Baseline characteristics were measured during the 12-month pre-index period, with continuous enrollment required, and were balanced using propensity score-based weighting. Individuals were followed from 14 days post-index to the earliest of: disenrollment, death, RSV vaccination, or end of the analysis period (May 31, 2024). Hazard ratios (HRs) were estimated using Cox proportional hazards regression, comparing risk of RSV-related hospitalization, with VE calculated as (1 - HR) x 100%. RESULTS: The study included 520,440 vaccinated and 2,081,760 unvaccinated individuals. Median follow-up was 5.6 months, with a maximum of 9.7 months. Estimated VE was 75.6% (95% confidence interval [CI]: 69.8-80.2%). VE estimates in key subgroups included 72.5% (64.3-78.8%) among those with chronic pulmonary disease, 72.2% (64.1-78.4%) among those with cardiovascular disease, 82.3% (74.2-87.9%) among those with diabetes, and 71.4% (57.0-81.1%) among those who were immunocompromised. INTERPRETATION: These findings highlight the effectiveness of adjuvanted RSVPreF3 vaccination in preventing RSV-related hospitalization among older adults, including those at increased risk, suggesting that vaccination is an effective strategy in reducing RSV disease burden.

papers.title: Bridging the Vaccine Gap: Scientific and Technological Advances for Diseases Lacking Effective Vaccines.
papers.abstract: Despite remarkable achievements in infectious disease control, more than 20 major pathogens responsible for significant global morbidity and mortality remain without licensed, effective vaccines. This so-called 'vaccine gap' disproportionately burdens low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), exacerbating health inequities and threatening global pandemic preparedness. This review comprehensively examines scientific and technological advances that are actively bridging the vaccine gap, with emphasis on novel platform technologies, immunological innovations, and translational strategies. We conducted a systematic narrative review of literature published between 2015 and 2024, encompassing peer-reviewed articles, WHO reports, clinical trial registries, and regulatory agency databases. Six transformative technology clusters were identified: (1) mRNA and self-amplifying RNA (saRNA) platforms enabling rapid antigen production; (2) viral-vectored vaccines with improved immune breadth; (3) structure-guided antigen design using cryo-electron microscopy and artificial intelligence (AI)-driven protein engineering; (4) broadly neutralising monoclonal antibodies as surrogate vaccine benchmarks; (5) mucosal and inhalable delivery systems targeting tissue-resident immunity; and (6) combination adjuvant systems amplifying magnitude and durability of protective responses. Clinical translation is exemplified by candidates against HIV-1, tuberculosis (TB), respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) in infants, and Plasmodium falciparum malaria. Convergence of AI-assisted rational antigen design, next-generation mRNA platforms, and innovative adjuvant-delivery pairings represents a paradigm shift toward vaccinatable diseases previously considered intractable. Equitable access frameworks and regulatory harmonisation across LMICs remain critical unresolved challenges.

papers.abstract_zh: 尽管在传染病控制方面取得了显著成就,但造成全球重大发病率和死亡率的 20 多种主要病原体仍然没有获得许可的有效疫苗。这种所谓的“疫苗缺口”给低收入和中等收入国家(LMIC)带来了不成比例的负担,加剧了健康不平等并威胁到全球大流行病的防范。这篇综述全面审视了积极缩小疫苗差距的科学和技术进步,重点关注新颖的平台技术、免疫学创新和转化策略。我们对 2015 年至 2024 年间发表的文献进行了系统的叙述性回顾,包括同行评审文章、世界卫生组织报告、临床试验登记和监管机构数据库。确定了六大变革性技术集群:(1) mRNA 和自扩增 RNA (saRNA) 平台,可实现快速抗原生产;(2) 提高免疫广度的病毒载体疫苗;(3)利用冷冻电子显微镜和人工智能(AI)驱动的蛋白质工程进行结构引导的抗原设计;(4) 广泛中和单克隆抗体作为替代疫苗基准;(5) 针对组织驻留免疫的粘膜和吸入递送系统;(6) 组合佐剂系统,增强保护反应的强度和持久性。临床转化的例子包括针对 HIV-1、结核病 (TB)、婴儿呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 和恶性疟原虫疟疾的候选药物。人工智能辅助的合理抗原设计、下一代 mRNA 平台和创新的佐剂递送配对的融合代表着向以前被认为难以治愈的可疫苗接种疾病的范式转变。中低收入国家的公平准入框架和监管协调仍然是尚未解决的重大挑战。

papers.title: Optimization of the antiviral spectrum of cyclophilin inhibitors targeting respiratory viruses.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT We evaluated the antiviral activity of a library of 36 urea-based small-molecule cyclophilin inhibitors (SMCypIs) against human respiratory syncytial virus (hRSV) and human metapneumovirus (hMPV). Structure–spectrum analysis revealed virus-specific structural requirements for antiviral efficacy. By combining the key determinants identified for each virus, we rationally designed optimized dual-acting derivatives. Among these, the optimized compound F832/33 emerged as a potent, broad-spectrum antiviral agent with nanomolar activity against both hRSV and hMPV, submicromolar inhibition of cyclophilin (Cyp) peptidyl-prolyl isomerase (PPIase) activity, and no detectable cytotoxicity. Interestingly, no direct correlation was observed between Cyp PPIase inhibition and antiviral potency, suggesting that Cyp engagement rather than enzymatic inhibition per se is required for antiviral activity. Competition assays with alisporivir confirmed that the antiviral effects of SMCypIs depend on their specific interaction with Cyp. Beyond its dual efficacy, F832/33 displayed strong antiviral activity against additional clinically relevant respiratory pathogens, including parainfluenza virus type 3, enterovirus D68, and both ancestral and Omicron severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 strains, in immortalized cell lines and fully differentiated human nasal epithelial cells, a physiologically relevant model of respiratory infection. Collectively, our results demonstrate that structure–activity relationship-guided optimization can be successfully applied to expand the antiviral spectrum of SMCypIs, positioning F832/33 as a promising host-targeted broad-spectrum antiviral candidate. Further in vivo studies are warranted to evaluate its therapeutic potential and clarify its precise mechanism of action.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 我们评估了 36 种基于尿素的小分子亲环蛋白抑制剂 (SMCypIs) 库对人呼吸道合胞病毒 (hRSV) 和人偏肺病毒 (hMPV) 的抗病毒活性。结构谱分析揭示了抗病毒功效的病毒特异性结构要求。通过结合每种病毒确定的关键决定因素,我们合理地设计了优化的双作用衍生物。其中,优化的化合物 F832/33 成为一种有效的广谱抗病毒剂,对 hRSV 和 hMPV 具有纳摩尔级活性,对亲环蛋白 (Cyp) 肽基脯氨酰异构酶 (PPIase) 活性具有亚微摩尔级抑制作用,且未检测到细胞毒性。有趣的是,在 Cyp PPIase 抑制和抗病毒效力之间没有观察到直接相关性,这表明抗病毒活性需要 Cyp 参与而不是酶抑制本身。阿拉泊韦的竞争试验证实,SMCypIs 的抗病毒作用取决于它们与 Cyp 的特异性相互作用。除了其双重功效之外,F832/33 在永生化细胞系和完全分化的人鼻上皮细胞(一种生理相关的呼吸道感染模型)中对其他临床相关呼吸道病原体(包括副流感病毒 3 型、肠道病毒 D68 以及祖先和 Omicron 严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒 2 株)表现出强大的抗病毒活性。总的来说,我们的结果表明,结构-活性关系引导的优化可以成功地应用于扩大 SMCypIs 的抗病毒谱,将 F832/33 定位为有前途的针对宿主的广谱抗病毒候选药物。需要进一步的体内研究来评估其治疗潜力并阐明其精确的作用机制。

papers.title: Trends of severe human metapneumovirus infections in India.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: In December 2024 and early January 2025, China reported increased acute respiratory infections with increased detections of seasonal influenza, rhinovirus, RSV and hMPV during the Northern Hemisphere winter. We strengthened hMPV surveillance through the existing pan-India surveillance network for acute respiratory illness (ARI) and severe acute respiratory infection (SARI). METHODOLOGY: To rapidly generate nationwide situational data without overburdening laboratories already performing routine respiratory virus surveillance, each site was asked to test up to five eligible SARI samples per week for hMPV from January to April 2025. Eligible samples were hospitalized SARI cases that were negative for influenza, SARS-CoV-2 and/or RSV, as applicable to age-based testing algorithms, across 70 laboratories. RESULTS: Of 8,246 enrolled SARI cases, 4,149 eligible samples were tested for hMPV under the capped weekly sampling strategy, and 59 were positive (1.42%; 95% CI: 1.10-1.83). Positivity ranged from 0.5% to 2.9% across age groups and was highest in children aged <2 years. Most patients (63%) were aged <2 years. Positivity was higher among males (1.7% vs 1.1% in females), and was highest in January (2.1%) before declining to 0.5% in April. The most common symptoms were cough (95%), fever (88%), and breathlessness (58%). Outcomes were available for 54/59 patients: 11 required ICU admission, 51 were discharged alive, and 3 died. Among seven patients with comorbidities, all were discharged alive. More than half of the sequenced viruses belonged to clade B1, followed by B2 and A2b2. CONCLUSION: In this limited sentinel surveillance of severe respiratory infections, hMPV was detected infrequently but was observed predominantly among young children. Continued multi-season surveillance is needed to better define age-specific burden, temporal patterns, and circulating genotypes in India. CLINICAL TRIAL NUMBER: Not applicable.

source_records.title: Trends of severe human metapneumovirus infections in India
source_records.abstract: BACKGROUND: In December 2024 and early January 2025, China reported increased acute respiratory infections with increased detections of seasonal influenza, rhinovirus, RSV and hMPV during the Northern Hemisphere winter. We strengthened hMPV surveillance through the existing pan-India surveillance network for acute respiratory illness (ARI) and severe acute respiratory infection (SARI). METHODOLOGY: To rapidly generate nationwide situational data without overburdening laboratories already performing routine respiratory virus surveillance, each site was asked to test up to five eligible SARI samples per week for hMPV from January to April 2025. Eligible samples were hospitalized SARI cases that were negative for influenza, SARS-CoV-2 and/or RSV, as applicable to age-based testing algorithms, across 70 laboratories. RESULTS: Of 8,246 enrolled SARI cases, 4,149 eligible samples were tested for hMPV under the capped weekly sampling strategy, and 59 were positive (1.42%; 95% CI: 1.10-1.83). Positivity ranged from 0.5% to 2.9% across age groups and was highest in children aged <2 years. Most patients (63%) were aged <2 years. Positivity was higher among males (1.7% vs 1.1% in females), and was highest in January (2.1%) before declining to 0.5% in April. The most common symptoms were cough (95%), fever (88%), and breathlessness (58%). Outcomes were available for 54/59 patients: 11 required ICU admission, 51 were discharged alive, and 3 died. Among seven patients with comorbidities, all were discharged alive. More than half of the sequenced viruses belonged to clade B1, followed by B2 and A2b2. CONCLUSION: In this limited sentinel surveillance of severe respiratory infections, hMPV was detected infrequently but was observed predominantly among young children. Continued multi-season surveillance is needed to better define age-specific burden, temporal patterns, and circulating genotypes in India. CLINICAL TRIAL NUMBER: Not applicable.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study was prompted by reports of increased acute respiratory infections and human metapneumovirus (hMPV) detections in China during the Northern Hemisphere winter of 2024-2025, aiming to assess the burden of severe hMPV infections in India.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This study utilized a sentinel surveillance network across 70 laboratories to test up to five eligible severe acute respiratory infection (SARI) samples per week for hMPV from January to April 2025.
analysis.methods: Eligible samples were defined as hospitalized SARI cases negative for influenza, SARS-CoV-2, and/or RSV, as per age-based testing algorithms, and were tested using a capped weekly sampling strategy.
analysis.main_results: Among 8,246 enrolled SARI cases, 4,149 eligible samples were tested, yielding a positivity rate of 1.42% (95% CI: 1.10-1.83), with the highest positivity in children under 2 years (0.5% to 2.9%) and males (1.7% vs 1.1% in females).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret their findings as indicating that while hMPV was detected infrequently in this limited sentinel surveillance, it was predominantly observed among young children, representing a novel assessment of its epidemiology in India.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results highlight the need for continued multi-season surveillance to better define age-specific burden, temporal patterns, and circulating genotypes of hMPV in India.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's limited scope as a sentinel surveillance and the capped weekly sampling strategy may not capture the full national burden, limiting the generalizability of the findings.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the burden of severe human metapneumovirus (hMPV) infections in India following reports of increased respiratory infections in China. Using a sentinel surveillance network across 70 laboratories, the researchers tested up to five eligible severe acute respiratory infection (SARI) samples per week for hMPV from January to April 2025. Among 8,246 enrolled SARI cases, 4,149 eligible samples were tested, yielding a positivity rate of 1.42% (95% CI: 1.10-1.83), with the highest positivity in children under 2 years (0.5% to 2.9%) and males (1.7% vs 1.1% in females). The most common symptoms were cough (95%), fever (88%), and breathlessness (58%). Outcomes were available for 54/59 patients, with 11 requiring ICU admission, 51 discharged alive, and 3 dying. The authors conclude that while hMPV was detected infrequently in this limited sentinel surveillance, it was predominantly observed among young children, highlighting the need for continued multi-season surveillance to better define age-specific burden, temporal patterns, and circulating genotypes in India.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 这项研究是根据有关 2024-2025 年北半球冬季中国急性呼吸道感染和人类偏肺病毒 (hMPV) 检测增加的报告而进行的,旨在评估印度严重 hMPV 感染的负担。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项研究利用覆盖 70 个实验室的哨点监测网络,从 2025 年 1 月到 4 月,每周对多达 5 个符合条件的严重急性呼吸道感染 (SARI) 样本进行 hMPV 检测。
elements_zh.methods: 根据基于年龄的测试算法,合格样本被定义为流感、SARS-CoV-2 和/或 RSV 呈阴性的住院 SARI 病例,并使用每周上限采样策略进行测试。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 8,246 例登记的 SARI 病例中,检测了 4,149 个符合条件的样本,阳性率为 1.42%(95% CI:1.10-1.83),其中 2 岁以下儿童(0.5% 至 2.9%)和男性(1.7% vs 女性 1.1%)阳性率最高。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将他们的发现解释为,虽然在这种有限的哨点监测中很少检测到 hMPV,但它主要在幼儿中观察到,这代表了对其在印度流行病学的新颖评估。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果强调需要持续进行多季节监测,以更好地确定印度 hMPV 的特定年龄负担、时间模式和循环基因型。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究作为哨点监测的范围有限,并且每周抽样策略有上限,可能无法涵盖全部国家负担,从而限制了研究结果的普遍性。

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:2024年12月至2025年1月初,中国报告急性呼吸道感染增加,北半球冬季期间季节性流感、鼻病毒、RSV和hMPV的检出率增加。我们通过现有的急性呼吸道疾病(ARI)和严重急性呼吸道感染(SARI)的泛印度监测网络加强了hMPV监测。方法:为在不过度增加已进行常规呼吸道病毒监测的实验室负担的情况下快速生成全国性态势数据,要求各站点在2025年1月至4月期间每周最多检测5份符合条件的SARI样本进行hMPV检测。符合条件的样本为70个实验室中年龄基于检测算法的住院SARI病例,且对流感、SARS-CoV-2和/或RSV呈阴性。结果:在8,246名入组的SARI病例中,根据每周采样上限策略,对4,149份符合条件的样本进行了hMPV检测,其中59份呈阳性(1.42%;95% CI:1.10-1.83)。各年龄组的阳性率范围为0.5%至2.9%,在<2岁儿童中最高。大多数患者(63%)年龄<2岁。男性阳性率较高(1.7% vs 女性1.1%),1月份最高(2.1%),随后在4月份降至0.5%。最常见的症状为咳嗽(95%)、发热(88%)和呼吸困难(58%)。54/59名患者的结局数据可用:11人需要ICU入住,51人存活出院,3人死亡。在7名有合并症的患者中,均存活出院。超过一半的测序病毒属于B1亚群,其次是B2和A2b2。结论:在这项针对严重呼吸道感染的有限哨点监测中,hMPV检出频率较低,但主要见于幼儿。需要继续进行多季节监测,以更好地定义印度特定年龄的负担、时间模式和循环基因型。临床试验编号:不适用。

papers.title: Shifts in seasonal timing of respiratory diseases and causes of death following a natural pandemic event.
papers.abstract: Seasonal respiratory infections typically surge within a limited time window, but what determines the exact timing within a given year is not well understood. Major causes of death show a similar seasonal pattern, but whether this pattern is linked to respiratory infections is unclear. The disruptions caused by the COVID-19 pandemic led to dramatic changes in the transmission dynamics of many respiratory pathogens, providing a unique opportunity to study the determinants of seasonal epidemics and the role of infectious diseases in driving seemingly unrelated causes of mortality. We analyzed publicly available data on weekly incidences of respiratory infections and all-cause mortality in Germany for the last 14 years. The analysis was complemented with results from an epidemiological model to determine the main drivers of seasonal timing. The timing of the seasonal epidemic of respiratory infections in Germany has been remarkably consistent for years, peaking during just few weeks in late winter. During the COVID-19 pandemic the seasonal surge in respiratory infections occurred substantially earlier, initially driven by the emerging COVID-19 and during later seasons by the resurgence of influenza and RSV. Remarkably, this shift was accompanied by a similar shift in the seasonality of all-cause mortality, and in particular mortality due to cardiovascular disease. The observed shift in epidemic timing is a consistent, but transient, outcome of disrupted epidemic seasonality, predictable from basic epidemiological principles. Our study reinforces that the buildup of susceptibles after the pandemic disruption was responsible for the shift in timing of the seasonal epidemic of respiratory infections. We show that more generally the rate of immune waning is the main determinant of the exact timing of seasonal epidemics of infectious diseases. The corresponding shift in seasonality of cardiovascular mortality suggests a connection between recent respiratory infections and severe cardiovascular events. This highlights the importance of monitoring individual infection history and improving vaccination coverage, in particular against influenza.

papers.title: Age-Dependent Differences in the Antiviral Response of the Respiratory Epithelium
papers.abstract: Age is an established risk factor for severe viral respiratory infections, yet the mechanisms driving increased severity of illness in infants and older adults remain incompletely understood. The respiratory epithelium is the primary target of viral infection and how it orchestrates the immune response may be a key determinant of clinical outcomes. The profound age-related difference in susceptibility to severe Coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) brought increased attention to the epithelial response to viral infection in children and adults, adding significant data to the preexisting body of work largely focused on influenza and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV). This review synthesizes current knowledge on the structural and functional differences in the respiratory epithelium between children and adults at baseline and during viral infection. We review the variable and heterogenous human studies in addition to in vitro and animal model data to identify key gaps in current knowledge. Here, we advocate for a more complete understanding of age-dependent differences in the respiratory epithelial response to viral infection to uncover therapeutic targets for prevention and treatment of viral-associated respiratory failure.

The profound age-related difference in susceptibility to severe Coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) brought increased attention to the epithelial response to viral infection in children and adults, adding significant data to the preexisting body of work largely focused on influenza and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV). This review synthesizes current knowledge on the structural and functional differences in the respiratory epithelium between children and adults at baseline and during viral infection. We review the variable and heterogenous human studies in addition to in vitro and animal model data to identify key gaps in current knowledge. Here, we advocate for a more complete understanding of age-dependent differences in the respiratory epithelial response to viral infection to uncover therapeutic targets for prevention and treatment of viral-associated respiratory failure.

papers.title: Changes in the pathogenic characteristics of hospitalized children with community-acquired pneumonia in Changzhou, China, 2018-2023.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Community-acquired pneumonia (CAP) is a significant cause of hospitalization and mortality in children. Non-pharmacological interventions (NPIs) implemented during the COVID-19 pandemic were associated with changes in the transmission dynamics of respiratory pathogens. The present study aimed to analyze changes in the pathogenic characteristics of hospitalized children with CAP in a single-center pediatric cohort in Changzhou, China, before and after the outbreak of COVID-19. METHODS: We retrospectively reviewed demographic information, hospitalization records, and pathogen-detection results of children admitted for CAP at Changzhou Children's Hospital, Jiangsu Province, China, from 2018 to 2023. The analyzed pathogens included eight target bacteria and seven respiratory viruses. RESULTS: A total of 29,552 children hospitalized with CAP were included, including 15,124 in the pre-pandemic period, 9024 in the pandemic period, and 5404 in the post-pandemic period. The male-to-female ratio was 1.42:1, and the median age was 16 months (IQR: 5.0-37.0). Hospitalizations generally peaked in autumn and winter from 2018 to 2022, whereas an off-season peak occurred in May 2023. The overall bacterial positivity increased from 9.94% before the pandemic to 13.96% during the pandemic and 13.68% after the pandemic, while viral positivity increased from 16.52% to 21.43% and 21.06%, respectively. In contrast, coinfection positivity decreased from 6.89% before the pandemic to 5.13% during the pandemic and 3.02% after the pandemic. Across all three periods, Escherichia coli consistently ranked first among bacterial detections, while RSV remained the predominant virus among viral detections. CONCLUSIONS: Noticeable shifts in the detection spectrum and positivity rates of common bacterial and viral pathogens were observed among hospitalized children with CAP following the implementation and relaxation of COVID-19 prevention and control policies. Continuous long-term surveillance is needed to refine targeted prevention strategies and optimize clinical treatment protocols for pediatric CAP. CLINICAL TRIAL: Not applicable.

papers.title: Respiratory viruses activate autophagy via the IFN-STAT1/STAT5B-SOCS1 axis.
papers.abstract: Abstract Autophagy is an ancient catabolic process that has emerged as part of the innate immunity. Upon infection, autophagy is activated but key factors responsible remained unclear. Here, we show that interferon (IFN) released during viral infections subsequently activates autophagy via STAT1/5B-mediated upregulation of SOCS1. Our data shows that scavenging of IFNs diminishes autophagy induced by several respiratory viruses. All types of IFN (I, II and III) mediated robust autophagic flux activation in both cell lines and primary human lung fibroblasts in a JAK1-3 dependent manner. Depletion or pharmacological inhibition of individual STAT transcription factors demonstrated that both STAT1 and STAT5B are required for IFN-induced autophagy. Upon IFN stimulation STAT1 and STAT5B associate and translocate to the nucleus. Transcriptome analyses revealed that inhibition of STAT5 only reduces expression of a subset of IFN-stimulated genes, whereas most known anti-viral IFN-stimulated genes remain induced to high levels. Among the STAT5 dependent genes was Suppressor of Cytokine Signaling 1 (SOCS1). Overexpression of SOCS1 stimulated autophagy, whereas its depletion impaired IFN-induced autophagy. Successful viruses like measles virus (MeV) or respiratory syncytial viruses (RSV) evolved strategies to exploit autophagy to promote their own replication. Uncoupling IFN-mediated ISG defenses from autophagy induction using by STAT5 inhibition reduced virus-induced autophagy, and inhibited efficient replication of autophagy-dependent MeV and RSV. Taken together, our data show that IFN promotes autophagy via STAT1/STAT5B-SOCS1 in viral infections and reveal that targeting of this axis allows inhibition of autophagy-dependent viruses without compromising innate immune defenses. Author summary Autophagy, like the Interferon (IFN) system, is considered part of the innate immune defenses that are activated upon viral infection. However, some viruses—like measles (MeV) and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV)—have learned to hijack this process to promote their replication. Our study shows that autophagy activation upon viral infections is promoted by the IFN system. Consequently, blocking IFNs reduced virus-induced autophagy. Mechanistic analyses demonstrated that various types of IFN induce expression of SOCS1, via the transcription factors STAT1 and STAT5B in cell lines and primary human lung cells. Pharmacological inhibition or depletion of STAT1, STAT5B or SOCS1 impaired IFN-induced autophagy. Importantly, disrupting STAT5 signaling does not impact IFN-mediated induction of the large majority of ISGs. Thus, selective disruption of IFN-induced autophagy by inhibiting STAT5 restricted replication of MeV and RSV. Our findings reveal an underappreciated mechanistic link between the IFN system and autophagy and suggest that targeting of the STAT5-SOCS1 axis may inhibit autophagy-dependent viruses without compromising IFN-mediated defenses.

papers.title_zh: 呼吸道病毒通过 IFN-STAT1/STAT5B-SOCS1 轴激活自噬。
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Autophagy is an ancient catabolic process that has emerged as part of the innate immunity. Upon infection, autophagy is activated but key factors responsible remained unclear. Here, we show that interferon (IFN) released during viral infections subsequently activates autophagy via STAT1/5B-mediated upregulation of SOCS1. Our data shows that scavenging of IFNs diminishes autophagy induced by several respiratory viruses. All types of IFN (I, II and III) mediated robust autophagic flux activation in both cell lines and primary human lung fibroblasts in a JAK1-3 dependent manner. Depletion or pharmacological inhibition of individual STAT transcription factors demonstrated that both STAT1 and STAT5B are required for IFN-induced autophagy. Upon IFN stimulation STAT1 and STAT5B associate and translocate to the nucleus. Transcriptome analyses revealed that inhibition of STAT5 only reduces expression of a subset of IFN-stimulated genes, whereas most known anti-viral IFN-stimulated genes remain induced to high levels. Among the STAT5 dependent genes was Suppressor of Cytokine Signaling 1 (SOCS1). Overexpression of SOCS1 stimulated autophagy, whereas its depletion impaired IFN-induced autophagy. Successful viruses like measles virus (MeV) or respiratory syncytial viruses (RSV) evolved strategies to exploit autophagy to promote their own replication. Uncoupling IFN-mediated ISG defenses from autophagy induction using by STAT5 inhibition reduced virus-induced autophagy, and inhibited efficient replication of autophagy-dependent MeV and RSV. Taken together, our data show that IFN promotes autophagy via STAT1/STAT5B-SOCS1 in viral infections and reveal that targeting of this axis allows inhibition of autophagy-dependent viruses without compromising innate immune defenses. Author summary Autophagy, like the Interferon (IFN) system, is considered part of the innate immune defenses that are activated upon viral infection. However, some viruses—like measles (MeV) and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV)—have learned to hijack this process to promote their replication. Our study shows that autophagy activation upon viral infections is promoted by the IFN system. Consequently, blocking IFNs reduced virus-induced autophagy. Mechanistic analyses demonstrated that various types of IFN induce expression of SOCS1, via the transcription factors STAT1 and STAT5B in cell lines and primary human lung cells. Pharmacological inhibition or depletion of STAT1, STAT5B or SOCS1 impaired IFN-induced autophagy. Importantly, disrupting STAT5 signaling does not impact IFN-mediated induction of the large majority of ISGs. Thus, selective disruption of IFN-induced autophagy by inhibiting STAT5 restricted replication of MeV and RSV. Our findings reveal an underappreciated mechanistic link between the IFN system and autophagy and suggest that targeting of the STAT5-SOCS1 axis may inhibit autophagy-dependent viruses without compromising IFN-mediated defenses.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 自噬是一种古老的分解代谢过程,是先天免疫的一部​​分。感染后,自噬被激活,但关键因素仍不清楚。在这里,我们发现病毒感染期间释放的干扰素 (IFN) 随后通过 STAT1/5B 介导的 SOCS1 上调激活自噬。我们的数据表明,干扰素的清除会减少几种呼吸道病毒诱导的自噬。所有类型的 IFN(I、II 和 III)以 JAK1-3 依赖性方式介导细胞系和原代人肺成纤维细胞中强大的自噬流激活。单个 STAT 转录因子的耗竭或药理抑制表明 STAT1 和 STAT5B 都是 IFN 诱导的自噬所必需的。在 IFN 刺激下,STAT1 和 STAT5B 结合并转移到细胞核。转录组分析显示,抑制 STAT5 仅降低一部分 IFN 刺激基因的表达,而大多数已知的抗病毒 IFN 刺激基因仍被诱导至高水平。STAT5 依赖性基因包括细胞因子信号传导抑制因子 1 (SOCS1)。SOCS1 的过度表达会刺激自噬,而其缺失会损害 IFN 诱导的自噬。麻疹病毒 (MeV) 或呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 等成功的病毒进化出了利用自噬促进自身复制的策略。通过抑制 STAT5 将 IFN 介导的 ISG 防御与自噬诱导解偶联,可减少病毒诱导的自噬,并抑制自噬依赖性 MeV 和 RSV 的有效复制。综上所述,我们的数据表明,在病毒感染中,IFN 通过 STAT1/STAT5B-SOCS1 促进自噬,并表明靶向该轴可以抑制自噬依赖性病毒,而不损害先天免疫防御。作者摘要 自噬与干扰素 (IFN) 系统一样,被认为是病毒感染时激活的先天免疫防御的一部分。然而,一些病毒——例如麻疹病毒(MeV)和呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)——已经学会劫持这个过程来促进它们的复制。我们的研究表明,病毒感染时的自噬激活是由 IFN 系统促进的。因此,阻断干扰素可减少病毒诱导的自噬。机制分析表明,各种类型的 IFN 通过细胞系和原代人肺细胞中的转录因子 STAT1 和 STAT5B 诱导 SOCS1 的表达。STAT1、STAT5B 或 SOCS1 的药理学抑制或耗竭会损害 IFN 诱导的自噬。重要的是,破坏 STAT5 信号传导不会影响 IFN 介导的大多数 ISG 的诱导。因此,通过抑制 STAT5 选择性破坏 IFN 诱导的自噬可限制 MeV 和 RSV 的复制。我们的研究结果揭示了 IFN 系统和自噬之间未被充分认识的机制联系,并表明靶向 STAT5-SOCS1 轴可以抑制自噬依赖性病毒,而不损害 IFN 介导的防御。
