papers.title: Interleukin 7 Receptor Alpha-Associated Severe Combined Immunodeficiency: Impact, Clinical Course, and Outcomes Following Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation
papers.abstract: Introduction Newborns with genetic variants in interleukin 7 receptor (IL7R) resulting in severe combined immunodeficiency (SCID) are commonly identified after an abnormal newborn screen. These patients experience profound T cell lymphopenia with varied humoral findings and are at risk for infection prior to definitive therapy. Definitive therapy includes hematopoietic stem cell transplant (HCT) and can result in immune reconstitution. Methods Retrospective chart review of four patients with IL7R SCID who were diagnosed through newborn screening in Maryland, Virginia, or Washington, D.C., and received HCT at Children’s National Hospital. Results All four patients were found when the newborn screening identified abnormal T cell receptor excision circle (TREC) values and were evaluated by immunology between 8-13 days of life. Each patient had markedly reduced CD3+ T cells at presentation (CD3+ 5-23 cells/mcL), variable B cells (CD19+ 354 cell/mcL–1,948 cells/mcL), and natural killer (NK) cell counts (CD16/56+ 288 cells/mcL–946 cells/mcL). Humoral profiles varied, with all patients exhibiting normal immunoglobulin G (IgG) and M (IgM). Two patients had absent immunoglobulin A (IgA) levels. Antifungal prophylaxis was initiated between days of life (DOL) 14-41. Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia (PJP) prophylaxis was initiated between DOL 30-41, and immunoglobulin replacement was initiated between DOL 30-53. Maternal CMV IgG was positive in three mothers. All mothers who had positive CMV IgG were asked to stop breastfeeding. One mother with detectable CMV stopped breastfeeding. All patients experienced pre-transplant infections ranging between upper respiratory infections, including parainfluenza, rhino/enterovirus, and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), and fungal infections, including candidal intertrigo of axilla and pityrosporum folliculitis. Transplant strategies encompassed haploidentical peripheral blood HCT (3 patients) and matched sibling donor marrow HCT (1 patient). One patient received anti-CD117 monoclonal antibody conditioning with graft failure necessitating subsequent HCT. Three patients received a preparative regime of busulfan, fludarabine, and rabbit antithymocyte globulin (rATG), and one patient received busulfan and fludarabine preparative regime. Post-transplant complications included CMV disease (retinitis, pneumonia, and enteric involvement) requiring virus-specific T cell therapy, hypertension, transaminitis, norovirus, and poor oral intake. All four patients demonstrated full donor T cell chimerism and mixed myeloid chimerism. Post-transplant immune assessments showed T cell reconstitution, improved lymphocyte proliferation to mitogens, and appropriate immunoglobulin values. Vaccine responses were protective to diphtheria, tetanus, and pneumococcal serotypes, and all patients were off chronic IgG replacement between 106–244 days after transplant. Conclusion In this cohort of four patients with IL7R SCID, newborn screening was essential for diagnosis and implementation of prophylactic treatment. Despite early intervention, patients with IL7R SCID may still experience pre-transplant complications such as upper respiratory infections or fungal infections. Early definitive therapy is essential and can lead to immune reconstitution.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines IL7R-associated severe combined immunodeficiency (SCID) in newborns identified via abnormal T cell receptor excision circle (TREC) newborn screening, focusing on clinical course, pre-transplant complications, and outcomes following hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (HCT). The central question addresses the impact of early diagnosis and intervention on immune reconstitution and infection control in this genetic disorder.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a retrospective chart review of four patients with IL7R SCID diagnosed through newborn screening in Maryland, Virginia, or Washington, D.C., and treated with HCT at Children’s National Hospital. The review reports transplant strategies, conditioning regimens, and post-transplant complications without specifying databases, search dates, or eligibility criteria beyond the cohort selection.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: All four patients demonstrated full donor T cell chimerism and mixed myeloid chimerism post-transplant, with T cell reconstitution, improved lymphocyte proliferation to mitogens, and appropriate immunoglobulin values. Vaccine responses were protective to diphtheria, tetanus, and pneumococcal serotypes, and all patients discontinued chronic immunoglobulin replacement within 106–244 days after transplant.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: One patient experienced graft failure following anti-CD117 monoclonal antibody conditioning, necessitating a subsequent HCT, highlighting variability in transplant outcomes. The review does not address long-term outcomes beyond early post-transplant period or broader population-level data for IL7R SCID.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review underscores the critical role of newborn screening in enabling early diagnosis and prophylactic interventions, including antifungal and PJP prophylaxis, immunoglobulin replacement, and maternal CMV IgG screening to mitigate pre-transplant infections. It suggests that early definitive therapy with HCT can achieve immune reconstitution but emphasizes the need for standardized protocols to address graft failure and infection risks.

analysis.summary_en: This review evaluates the clinical course and outcomes of four newborns with IL7R-associated SCID identified via TREC newborn screening and treated with HCT. All patients achieved full donor T cell chimerism and immune reconstitution post-transplant, with protective vaccine responses and discontinuation of immunoglobulin replacement within 106–244 days. However, one patient experienced graft failure requiring repeat HCT, and pre-transplant infections, including viral and fungal, were common despite early prophylaxis. The findings highlight the essential role of newborn screening in enabling timely intervention and underscore the need for standardized protocols to optimize transplant outcomes and infection control.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述检查了通过异常 T 细胞受体切除圈 (TREC) 新生儿筛查发现的新生儿中与 IL7R 相关的严重联合免疫缺陷 (SCID),重点关注临床病程、移植前并发症以及造血干细胞移植 (HCT) 后的结果。核心问题涉及早期诊断和干预对这种遗传性疾病的免疫重建和感染控制的影响。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该审查是对四名 IL7R SCID 患者的回顾性图表审查,这些患者是通过马里兰州、弗吉尼亚州或华盛顿特区的新生儿筛查诊断出来的,并在国家儿童医院接受了 HCT 治疗。该综述报告了移植策略、预处理方案和移植后并发症,但没有指定数据库、搜索日期或队列选择之外的资格标准。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 所有四名患者在移植后均表现出完全供体 T 细胞嵌合和混合骨髓嵌合,并具有 T 细胞重建、改善的淋巴细胞增殖至丝裂原以及适当的免疫球蛋白值。疫苗反应对白喉、破伤风和肺炎球菌血清型具有保护作用,所有患者在移植后 106-244 天内停止慢性免疫球蛋白替代。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 一名患者在抗 CD117 单克隆抗体调理后出现移植失败,需要随后进行 HCT,这凸显了移植结果的可变性。该综述不涉及移植后早期以外的长期结果或更广泛的 IL7R SCID 人群水平数据。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该综述强调了新生儿筛查在早期诊断和预防性干预方面的关键作用,包括抗真菌和 PJP 预防、免疫球蛋白替代以及母体 CMV IgG 筛查以减轻移植前感染。它表明 HCT 的早期确定性治疗可以实现免疫重建,但强调需要标准化方案来解决移植失败和感染风险。

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述检查了通过异常 T 细胞受体切除圈 (TREC) 新生儿筛查发现的新生儿中与 IL7R 相关的严重联合免疫缺陷 (SCID),重点关注临床病程、移植前并发症以及造血干细胞移植 (HCT) 后的结果。核心问题涉及早期诊断和干预对这种遗传性疾病的免疫重建和感染控制的影响。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该审查是对四名 IL7R SCID 患者的回顾性图表审查,这些患者是通过马里兰州、弗吉尼亚州或华盛顿特区的新生儿筛查诊断出来的,并在国家儿童医院接受了 HCT 治疗。该综述报告了移植策略、预处理方案和移植后并发症,但没有指定数据库、搜索日期或队列选择之外的资格标准。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 所有四名患者在移植后均表现出完全供体 T 细胞嵌合和混合骨髓嵌合,并具有 T 细胞重建、改善的淋巴细胞增殖至丝裂原以及适当的免疫球蛋白值。疫苗反应对白喉、破伤风和肺炎球菌血清型具有保护作用,所有患者在移植后 106-244 天内停止慢性免疫球蛋白替代。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 一名患者在抗 CD117 单克隆抗体调理后出现移植失败,需要随后进行 HCT,这凸显了移植结果的可变性。该综述不涉及移植后早期以外的长期结果或更广泛的 IL7R SCID 人群水平数据。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该综述强调了新生儿筛查在早期诊断和预防性干预方面的关键作用,包括抗真菌和 PJP 预防、免疫球蛋白替代以及母体 CMV IgG 筛查以减轻移植前感染。它表明 HCT 的早期确定性治疗可以实现免疫重建,但强调需要标准化方案来解决移植失败和感染风险。

papers.title: CAUSAL-RSV: Causal Analysis of RSV Vaccine Effects in Infants Using Real-World Data
papers.abstract: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) contributes to substantial morbidity and mortality in young children each year. In 2023, two new prevention products were licensed and recommended in the United States (US), including a prefusion F protein subunit vaccine (RSVpreF) administered during pregnancy and a long-acting monoclonal antibody (mAb) administered in infants. Although post-licensure real-world studies support the effectiveness of RSVpreF vaccine during pregnancy, existing studies have been conducted in settings where only RSVpreF vaccine is available. The real-world effectiveness of RSVpreF vaccine in settings where both RSVpreF vaccine and mAbs are available is not yet well understood. The goal of this study is to estimate the real-world effectiveness of the RSVpreF vaccine against severe infant RSV by applying causal mediation analysis with receipt of mAbs as a mediating variable. Using a national cohort of mother-infant dyads with the Optum Labs Data Warehouse (OLDW), we will model vaccine and mAb effects in a longitudinal cohort spanning the 2023-24, 2024-25, and 2025-26 RSV seasons. Results will be used to better understand the total effect of RSVpreF vaccination when it is used as one component within a hybrid infant RSV prevention program.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究的目的是通过应用因果中介分析(以单克隆抗体作为中介变量)来评估 RSVpreF 疫苗针对严重婴儿 RSV 的实际有效性。
elements_zh.methods: 利用 Optum Labs 数据仓库 (OLDW) 的全国母婴队列,我们​​将在跨越 2023-24、2024-25 和 2025-26 RSV 季节的纵向队列中模拟疫苗和单克隆抗体的效果。
elements_zh.main_results: 当 RSVpreF 疫苗用作混合婴儿 RSV 预防计划的一个组成部分时,结果将用于更好地了解 RSVpreF 疫苗接种的总体效果。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 尽管获得许可后的真实世界研究支持 RSVpreF 疫苗在怀孕期间的有效性,但现有研究是在仅提供 RSVpreF 疫苗的环境中进行的。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 2023年,两种新的预防产品在美国获得许可和推荐,包括在怀孕期间注射的预融合F蛋白亚单位疫苗(RSVpreF)和在婴儿中注射的长效单克隆抗体(mAb)。

papers.title_zh: CAUSAL-RSV:使用真实世界数据对婴儿 RSV 疫苗效果进行因果分析
papers.source_body_en: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) contributes to substantial morbidity and mortality in young children each year. In 2023, two new prevention products were licensed and recommended in the United States (US), including a prefusion F protein subunit vaccine (RSVpreF) administered during pregnancy and a long-acting monoclonal antibody (mAb) administered in infants. Although post-licensure real-world studies support the effectiveness of RSVpreF vaccine during pregnancy, existing studies have been conducted in settings where only RSVpreF vaccine is available. The real-world effectiveness of RSVpreF vaccine in settings where both RSVpreF vaccine and mAbs are available is not yet well understood. The goal of this study is to estimate the real-world effectiveness of the RSVpreF vaccine against severe infant RSV by applying causal mediation analysis with receipt of mAbs as a mediating variable. Using a national cohort of mother-infant dyads with the Optum Labs Data Warehouse (OLDW), we will model vaccine and mAb effects in a longitudinal cohort spanning the 2023-24, 2024-25, and 2025-26 RSV seasons. Results will be used to better understand the total effect of RSVpreF vaccination when it is used as one component within a hybrid infant RSV prevention program.
papers.abstract_zh: 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 每年都会导致幼儿大量发病和死亡。2023年,两种新的预防产品在美国获得许可和推荐,包括在怀孕期间注射的预融合F蛋白亚单位疫苗(RSVpreF)和在婴儿中注射的长效单克隆抗体(mAb)。尽管获得许可后的真实世界研究支持 RSVpreF 疫苗在怀孕期间的有效性,但现有研究是在仅提供 RSVpreF 疫苗的环境中进行的。在同时提供 RSVpreF 疫苗和 mAb 的环境中,RSVpreF 疫苗的实际有效性尚不清楚。本研究的目的是通过应用因果中介分析(以单克隆抗体作为中介变量)来评估 RSVpreF 疫苗针对严重婴儿 RSV 的实际有效性。利用 Optum Labs 数据仓库 (OLDW) 的全国母婴队列,我们​​将在跨越 2023-24、2024-25 和 2025-26 RSV 季节的纵向队列中模拟疫苗和单克隆抗体的效果。当 RSVpreF 疫苗用作混合婴儿 RSV 预防计划的一个组成部分时,结果将用于更好地了解 RSVpreF 疫苗接种的总体效果。

papers.title: Dynamic regulation-based stabilizing mutations are highly effective for designing RSV pre-fusion F mRNA vaccines
papers.abstract: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is a leading cause of respiratory tract infections and poses a serious threat to young children, older adults, and immunocompromised individuals. We previously designed a pre-fusion stabilized F protein (pre-F), TriM-5, using a dynamic regulation mechanism, and produced a recombinant protein-based vaccine candidate that exhibited potent protection against RSV. However, several studies have revealed that the stabilization of pre-F achieved in protein form may not be sufficient for application in mRNA vaccine development. Here, based on TriM-5, we designed an mRNA vaccine candidate to assess whether the dynamic regulation-based stabilizing mutations of TriM-5 are also effective in an mRNA format. The TriM-5 mRNA was codon-optimized using in-house software named NVSI_GAmRNAopt, which employed a genetic algorithm incorporating multiple empirical parameters for coding sequence (CDS) optimization, and encapsulated using lipid nanoparticles (LNPs). Mouse immunization showed that after CDS optimization, the IgG antibody titers increased approximately threefold, indicating the effectiveness of our codon-optimization algorithm. Compared with the Moderna RSV mRNA sequence encapsulated with our proprietary BM028 LNPs, the TriM-5 mRNA-LNP induced 3.03-fold higher neutralizing antibody titers against RSV A2 virus, along with significantly higher IFN-γ, IL-5 and IL-17A secretion levels, indicating its superior immunogenicity. Virus challenge experiments demonstrated that both TriM-5 mRNA-LNP and Moderna mRNA-LNP reduced lung viral loads effectively, with no obvious lung pathology. The designed TriM-5 mRNA-LNP exhibits good immunogenicity and protective efficacy, and thereby may serve as a promising candidate for further vaccine development.

papers.title: Targeting the HMGB1 Pathway With Glycyrrhizic Acid and Amlexanox Attenuates RSV-Induced Injury and Viral Propagation.
papers.abstract: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is the leading cause of acute respiratory infections globally, with particularly severe implications for infants and the elderly population. Despite the substantial burden on public health, effective therapeutic options for the treatment of RSV infections remain limited. The pathogenesis of RSV is characterized by complex inflammatory responses, while high-mobility group box 1 (HMGB1), a damage-associated molecular pattern protein, is known to play a role in amplifying inflammation. However, the specific role of HMGB1 in RSV infection has not been thoroughly investigated. This study aims to elucidate the role of HMGB1 in RSV replication and to evaluate its potential as a target for antiviral therapy. The interaction between the RSV nucleocapsid (N) protein and HMGB1 was demonstrated through co-immunoprecipitation and mass spectrometry. Knockdown or overexpression of HMGB1 by small interfering RNA or pCMV-HA-HMGB1 resulted in a significant reduction or induction in RSV replication in vitro, thereby confirming the critical role of HMGB1 in viral propagation. Moreover, structure-based molecular docking analyses identified glycyrrhizic acid (GA) and amlexanox (AMX) as high-affinity ligands for HMGB1. In cellular studies, both GA and AMX effectively inhibited RSV replication in a dose-dependent manner while selectively suppressing HMGB1's secretion to the cytoplasm or extracellular space from RSV-infected cells. AMX was found to down-regulate HMGB1 expression while GA did not. In experiments using lethal murine RSV infection models, treatment with GA and AMX significantly improved survival rates and reduced lung pathology. In conclusion, these findings suggest that HMGB1 is a promising therapeutic target for RSV infection and highlight GA and AMX as potential antiviral candidates that can modulate HMGB1-mediated immunopathology.

papers.abstract_zh: 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 是全球急性呼吸道感染的主要原因,对婴儿和老年人群的影响尤其严重。尽管给公共卫生带来了巨大负担,但治疗 RSV 感染的有效治疗选择仍然有限。RSV 的发病机制以复杂的炎症反应为特征,而高迁移率族蛋白 1 (HMGB1)(一种损伤相关分子模式蛋白)已知在放大炎症中发挥作用。然而,HMGB1在RSV感染中的具体作用尚未得到彻底研究。本研究旨在阐明 HMGB1 在 RSV 复制中的作用并评估其作为抗病毒治疗靶点的潜力。通过免疫共沉淀和质谱分析证实了 RSV 核衣壳 (N) 蛋白和 HMGB1 之间的相互作用。通过小干扰RNA或pCMV-HA-HMGB1敲低或过度表达HMGB1导致RSV体外复制显着减少或诱导,从而证实了HMGB1在病毒传播中的关键作用。此外,基于结构的分子对接分析确定甘草酸 (GA) 和氨来呫诺 (AMX) 是 HMGB1 的高亲和力配体。在细胞研究中,GA和AMX均以剂量依赖性方式有效抑制RSV复制,同时选择性抑制RSV感染细胞向细胞质或细胞外间隙分泌HMGB1。发现 AMX 下调 HMGB1 表达,而 GA 则不然。在使用致死性鼠 RSV 感染模型的实验中,GA 和 AMX 治疗显着提高了存活率并减少了肺部病变。总之,这些发现表明 HMGB1 是 RSV 感染的一个有前途的治疗靶点,并强调 GA 和 AMX 作为可以调节 HMGB1 介导的免疫病理学的潜在抗病毒候选药物。

papers.title: Editorial: Impact of viral infections on childhood asthma: susceptibility and pathomechanisms
papers.abstract: A fundamental question in pediatric respiratory medicine is why certain children experience severe viral respiratory infections and long-term sequelae, whereas their peers recover without apparent consequences. To address this issue, Lu et al. investigated genetic susceptibility associated with RSVrelated hospitalization in a cohort of Taiwanese children (6). The authors identified genetic variants potentially associated with increased susceptibility to severe RSV infection requiring hospitalization. Although preliminary, these findings contribute to a growing body of evidence indicating that host genetic factors influence the clinical response to respiratory viral infections (7,8). Understanding the genetic determinants of severe RSV disease may help identify children at elevated risk of adverse respiratory outcomes and provide insights into the biological pathways linking viral infection and asthma pathogenesis.The importance of host susceptibility is intricately explored in the Perspective article by Pischedda et al., which examined whether early-life RSV infection may induce epigenetic changes that promote asthma development (9). While epidemiological studies have consistently reported an association between severe RSV infection during infancy and later asthma, the mechanisms underlying this relationship remain controversial, thus warranting further investigation (4,5). discuss emerging evidence of epigenetics suggesting that RSV infection may influence DNA methylation patterns, histone modifications, and non-coding RNA regulation, resulting in long-term alterations of immune responses and airway function. Such epigenetic modifications could provide a mechanistic bridge between transient viral exposure and persistent respiratory disease. Importantly, this perspective highlights the possibility that early-life infections occurring during critical developmental windows may leave a lasting biological imprint that shapes future susceptibility to asthma. The integration of epigenetic research into studies of respiratory disease offers promising opportunities to understand disease origins and identify novel preventive strategies, particularly in early childhood (10).Together, the studies by Lu et al. and Pischedda et al. emphasize that the consequences of viral infections are determined not only by pathogen exposure but also by host-specific biological factors operating at multiple levels. Genetic predisposition may influence susceptibility to severe infection, while epigenetic responses may contribute to long-term alterations in airway and immune function.Beyond disease inception, viral infections remain among the most important triggers of asthma morbidity in children (11). In this context, Jones et al. provide valuable epidemiological insights describing changing patterns of viral infection severity in a pediatric asthma cohort during the transition from COVID-19 lockdown measures to post-pandemic recovery (12). Public health interventions implemented during the COVID-19 pandemic dramatically altered the circulation of common respiratory viruses, creating a unique opportunity to examine the relationship between viral exposure and asthma outcomes. The authors observed evolving patterns of viral infections and disease severity as community social restrictions were relaxed and viral circulation resumed. Their findings illustrate the profound influence that changes in viral epidemiology can have on children with asthma, which underscores the dynamic nature of respiratory disease risk. The study also highlights how population-level factors, including behavioral and environmental changes, may interact with individual susceptibility to shape asthma morbidity. The observations reported by Jones et al. have broader implications for understanding asthma exacerbations. They reinforce the concept that respiratory viruses remain a major driver of acute disease burden and suggest that surveillance of viral circulation may play a vital role in predicting periods of increased risk for pediatric asthmatics. Furthermore, the study demonstrates how disruptions in viral exposure patterns can influence disease expression, offering new perspectives on the interactions between infection, immunity, and airway inflammation.Although viral infections are central to asthma pathogenesis and exacerbation, they occur within a broader context of allergic and environmental influences. contribute to this understanding by characterizing allergen sensitization patterns among children with asthma in China in a retrospective cohort study (13). The authors identified distinct allergen profiles and demonstrated considerable heterogeneity in sensitization patterns among pediatric patients. Although the study focused primarily on allergic factors rather than viral infections, its findings remain highly relevant to this Research Topic, since allergic sensitization is a key determinant of asthma phenotype and severity and may substantially influence the host response to respiratory viral infections. Previous studies have suggested that allergic airway inflammation can impair antiviral immune responses, potentially increasing susceptibility to virus-induced exacerbations. Conversely, viral infections may amplify preexisting allergic inflammation, creating a cycle that contributes to disease persistence and worsening symptoms (14). The study by Hu et al., therefore, complements the viral-focused investigations presented in this collection by emphasizing the importance of considering asthma as a heterogeneous disease arising from multiple interacting biological pathways. Viral infections, allergic sensitization, and host susceptibility factors should not be perceived as independent determinants but rather as interconnected components of a complex disease network. Taken together, these studies provide a multidimensional view of childhood asthma, highlighting viral infections as a central but interconnected factor. Genetic, epigenetic, environmental, and allergic influences all shape susceptibility, disease burden, and responses to infection, underscoring the need for an integrated approach spanning molecular mechanisms to population-based epidemiology.Several important questions remain to be addressed regarding the link between viral infection and the development of pediatric asthma. Future longitudinal studies are needed to clarify the causal relationships between viral infections, epigenetic modifications, and asthma development. Larger and more diverse genetic studies may help identify robust susceptibility markers and uncover biological pathways amenable to intervention. Integrative approaches combining genomic, epigenomic, immunological, environmental, and clinical data will likely be necessary to fully characterize the mechanisms linking viral infections and asthma. Furthermore, recent advances in RSV prevention, including maternal immunization and long-acting monoclonal antibodies, provide unprecedented opportunities to evaluate whether reducing early-life viral disease can alter the trajectory of respiratory health and decrease the risk of subsequent asthma (15,16).In summary, the contributions assembled in this Research Topic highlight the role of viral infections in childhood asthma. By examining genetic susceptibility, epigenetic regulation, epidemiological trends, and allergic sensitization, these studies advance our understanding of the complex pathways connecting viral exposure to asthma development and exacerbation. Continued interdisciplinary research in this field will be essential for developing more effective strategies for prevention and management of pediatric asthma and ultimately reducing the global burden of the disease.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines why some children develop severe viral respiratory infections and long-term sequelae such as asthma, focusing on host genetic and epigenetic factors, viral epidemiology, and allergic sensitization in pediatric populations (A1, A6, A14). It explores the central question of how viral infections interact with host-specific biological determinants to influence susceptibility, disease severity, and asthma outcomes in children (A1, A6, A14).
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The editorial synthesizes findings from multiple studies without conducting a formal systematic review or meta-analysis. It references cohort and perspective studies investigating genetic susceptibility to RSV hospitalization (A3), epigenetic mechanisms linking RSV to asthma (A6), changes in viral epidemiology post-COVID-19 lockdowns (A16), and allergen sensitization patterns in Chinese children with asthma (A25). The review does not report databases, search dates, eligibility criteria, or study counts (A2, A6, A16, A25).
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that host genetic factors influence susceptibility to severe RSV infection, with preliminary evidence identifying genetic variants associated with increased risk of hospitalization (A4, A5). It also highlights emerging evidence that RSV infection may induce epigenetic changes, such as DNA methylation and histone modifications, which could mechanistically link early-life viral exposure to long-term alterations in immune responses and airway function (A8, A9, A10). Additionally, viral infections remain a major trigger of asthma morbidity in children, and changes in viral circulation post-pandemic have demonstrated dynamic impacts on disease severity (A14, A18, A19, A23).
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The mechanisms underlying the association between severe RSV infection and later asthma development remain controversial and require further investigation (A7). The review notes that while epidemiological studies consistently report this association, the biological pathways linking transient viral exposure to persistent respiratory disease are not fully understood (A7, A8). It also highlights the need for larger and more diverse genetic studies to identify robust susceptibility markers and clarify causal relationships between viral infections, epigenetic modifications, and asthma development (A34, A35).
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review emphasizes the need for longitudinal studies to clarify causal relationships between viral infections, epigenetic modifications, and asthma development (A34). It also calls for integrative approaches combining genomic, epigenomic, immunological, environmental, and clinical data to fully characterize the mechanisms linking viral infections and asthma (A36). Surveillance of viral circulation is suggested as a vital tool for predicting periods of increased risk for pediatric asthmatics, particularly during transitions in public health measures (A23).

analysis.summary_en: This editorial explores the interplay between viral infections and childhood asthma, focusing on host genetic susceptibility, epigenetic mechanisms, viral epidemiology, and allergic sensitization. It synthesizes evidence from cohort and perspective studies indicating that genetic variants may increase susceptibility to severe RSV infection, while RSV-induced epigenetic changes could mechanistically link early-life viral exposure to long-term airway and immune alterations. The review highlights the dynamic impact of viral circulation changes post-COVID-19 lockdowns on asthma severity and underscores the need for longitudinal and integrative research to clarify causal pathways and identify predictive biomarkers.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述探讨了为什么一些儿童会出现严重的病毒性呼吸道感染和哮喘等长期后遗症,重点关注宿主遗传和表观遗传因素、病毒流行病学以及儿科人群的过敏反应(A1、A6、A14)。它探讨了病毒感染如何与宿主特异性生物决定因素相互作用以影响儿童的易感性、疾病严重程度和哮喘结果的核心问题(A1、A6、A14)。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该社论综合了多项研究的结果,但没有进行正式的系统评价或荟萃分析。它参考了队列研究和前瞻性研究,调查了 RSV 住院的遗传易感性 (A3)、RSV 与哮喘相关的表观遗传机制 (A6)、COVID-19 封锁后病毒流行病学的变化 (A16) 以及中国哮喘儿童的过敏原敏化模式 (A25)。该综述不报告数据库、检索日期、资格标准或研究计数(A2、A6、A16、A25)。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该综述得出的结论是,宿主遗传因素影响对严重 RSV 感染的易感性,初步证据表明遗传变异与住院风险增加相关 (A4、A5)。它还强调了新出现的证据表明,RSV 感染可能会引起表观遗传变化,例如 DNA 甲基化和组蛋白修饰,这可能在机制上将生命早期病毒暴露与免疫反应和气道功能的长期变化联系起来 (A8、A9、A10)。此外,病毒感染仍然是儿童哮喘发病的主要诱因,大流行后病毒循环的变化已证明对疾病严重程度具有动态影响(A14、A18、A19、A23)。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 严重 RSV 感染与后期哮喘发展之间的关联机制仍存在争议,需要进一步研究 (A7)。该评论指出,虽然流行病学研究一致报告了这种关联,但暂时性病毒暴露与持续性呼吸道疾病之间的生物学途径尚未完全了解(A7、A8)。它还强调需要进行更大规模、更多样化的遗传学研究,以确定可靠的易感性标记,并阐明病毒感染、表观遗传修饰和哮喘发展之间的因果关系(A34、A35)。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该综述强调需要进行纵向研究来阐明病毒感染、表观遗传修饰和哮喘发展之间的因果关系(A34)。它还呼吁采用结合基因组、表观基因组、免疫学、环境和临床数据的综合方法,以充分描述病毒感染和哮喘之间的联系机制(A36)。建议将病毒循环监测作为预测儿童哮喘风险增加时期的重要工具,特别是在公共卫生措施转变期间 (A23)。

Furthermore, the study demonstrates how disruptions in viral exposure patterns can influence disease expression, offering new perspectives on the interactions between infection, immunity, and airway inflammation.Although viral infections are central to asthma pathogenesis and exacerbation, they occur within a broader context of allergic and environmental influences. contribute to this understanding by characterizing allergen sensitization patterns among children with asthma in China in a retrospective cohort study (13). The authors identified distinct allergen profiles and demonstrated considerable heterogeneity in sensitization patterns among pediatric patients. Although the study focused primarily on allergic factors rather than viral infections, its findings remain highly relevant to this Research Topic, since allergic sensitization is a key determinant of asthma phenotype and severity and may substantially influence the host response to respiratory viral infections. Previous studies have suggested that allergic airway inflammation can impair antiviral immune responses, potentially increasing susceptibility to virus-induced exacerbations. Conversely, viral infections may amplify preexisting allergic inflammation, creating a cycle that contributes to disease persistence and worsening symptoms (14). The study by Hu et al., therefore, complements the viral-focused investigations presented in this collection by emphasizing the importance of considering asthma as a heterogeneous disease arising from multiple interacting biological pathways. Viral infections, allergic sensitization, and host susceptibility factors should not be perceived as independent determinants but rather as interconnected components of a complex disease network. Taken together, these studies provide a multidimensional view of childhood asthma, highlighting viral infections as a central but interconnected factor. Genetic, epigenetic, environmental, and allergic influences all shape susceptibility, disease burden, and responses to infection, underscoring the need for an integrated approach spanning molecular mechanisms to population-based epidemiology.Several important questions remain to be addressed regarding the link between viral infection and the development of pediatric asthma. Future longitudinal studies are needed to clarify the causal relationships between viral infections, epigenetic modifications, and asthma development. Larger and more diverse genetic studies may help identify robust susceptibility markers and uncover biological pathways amenable to intervention. Integrative approaches combining genomic, epigenomic, immunological, environmental, and clinical data will likely be necessary to fully characterize the mechanisms linking viral infections and asthma. Furthermore, recent advances in RSV prevention, including maternal immunization and long-acting monoclonal antibodies, provide unprecedented opportunities to evaluate whether reducing early-life viral disease can alter the trajectory of respiratory health and decrease the risk of subsequent asthma (15,16).In summary, the contributions assembled in this Research Topic highlight the role of viral infections in childhood asthma. By examining genetic susceptibility, epigenetic regulation, epidemiological trends, and allergic sensitization, these studies advance our understanding of the complex pathways connecting viral exposure to asthma development and exacerbation. Continued interdisciplinary research in this field will be essential for developing more effective strategies for prevention and management of pediatric asthma and ultimately reducing the global burden of the disease.
papers.abstract_zh: 儿科呼吸医学的一个基本问题是,为什么某些儿童会经历严重的病毒性呼吸道感染和长期后遗症,而他们的同龄人却能康复而没有明显的后果。为了解决这个问题,Lu 等人。在一组台湾儿童中调查了与 RSV 相关住院相关的遗传易感性 (6)。作者发现了可能与需要住院治疗的严重 RSV 感染易感性增加相关的基因变异。尽管这些发现是初步的,但越来越多的证据表明宿主遗传因素影响呼吸道病毒感染的临床反应 (7,8)。了解严重 RSV 疾病的遗传决定因素可能有助于识别出现不良呼吸道后果的高风险儿童,并深入了解病毒感染和哮喘发病机制之间的生物学途径。Pischedda 等人在 Perspective 文章中深入探讨了宿主易感性的重要性,该文章研究了生命早期 RSV 感染是否可能诱发促进哮喘发展的表观遗传变化 (9)。虽然流行病学研究一致报道婴儿期严重 RSV 感染与后期哮喘之间存在关联,但这种关系背后的机制仍然存在争议,因此需要进一步研究 (4,5)。讨论表观遗传学的新证据表明 RSV 感染可能影响 DNA 甲基化模式、组蛋白修饰和非编码 RNA 调节,从而导致免疫反应和气道功能的长期改变。这种表观遗传修饰可以在短暂的病毒暴露和持续性呼吸道疾病之间提供一座机制桥梁。重要的是,这一观点强调了一种可能性,即在关键发育窗口期间发生的早期感染可能会留下持久的生物印记,从而影响未来对哮喘的易感性。将表观遗传学研究整合到呼吸道疾病研究中,为了解疾病起源和确定新的预防策略提供了有希望的机会,特别是在儿童早期 (10)。和皮斯切达等人。强调病毒感染的后果不仅取决于病原体暴露,还取决于在多个层面上发挥作用的宿主特异性生物因素。遗传易感性可能会影响严重感染的易感性,而表观遗传反应可能会导致气道和免疫功能的长期改变。除了疾病发生之外,病毒感染仍然是儿童哮喘发病的最重要诱因之一(11)。在这种情况下,琼斯等人。提供了有价值的流行病学见解,描述了从 COVID-19 封锁措施到大流行后恢复期间儿童哮喘队列中病毒感染严重程度的变化模式 (12)。COVID-19 大流行期间实施的公共卫生干预措施极大地改变了常见呼吸道病毒的传播,为研究病毒暴露与哮喘结果之间的关系创造了独特的机会。作者观察到,随着社区社会限制的放松和病毒循环的恢复,病毒感染和疾病严重程度的变化模式。他们的研究结果说明了病毒流行病学的变化可能对哮喘儿童产生的深远影响,这强调了呼吸道疾病风险的动态性质。该研究还强调了人口因素(包括行为和环境变化)如何与个体易感性相互作用,从而影响哮喘发病率。琼斯等人报告的观察结果。对于理解哮喘急性发作具有更广泛的意义。他们强化了这样一个概念,即呼吸道病毒仍然是急性疾病负担的主要驱动因素,并表明病毒循环的监测可能在预测儿童哮喘风险增加时期发挥至关重要的作用。此外,该研究证明了病毒暴露模式的破坏如何影响疾病的表达,为感染、免疫和气道炎症之间的相互作用提供了新的视角。尽管病毒感染是哮喘发病机制和恶化的核心,但它们发生在过敏和环境影响的更广泛背景下。通过在一项回顾性队列研究中描述中国哮喘儿童的过敏原致敏模式,有助于理解这一点 (13)。作者确定了不同的过敏原特征,并证明儿科患者的致敏模式存在相当大的异质性。尽管该研究主要关注过敏因素而不是病毒感染,但其发现仍然与本研究主题高度相关,因为过敏致敏是哮喘表型和严重程度的关键决定因素,并可能极大地影响宿主对呼吸道病毒感染的反应。先前的研究表明,过敏性气道炎症会损害抗病毒免疫反应,可能增加对病毒引起的病情加重的易感性。相反,病毒感染可能会加剧已有的过敏性炎症,形成导致疾病持续存在和症状恶化的循环 (14)。因此,Hu 等人的研究通过强调将哮喘视为由多种相互作用的生物途径引起的异质性疾病的重要性,补充了本集中提出的以病毒为重点的研究。病毒感染、过敏性致敏和宿主易感因素不应被视为独立的决定因素,而应被视为复杂疾病网络中相互关联的组成部分。总而言之,这些研究提供了儿童哮喘的多维视角,强调病毒感染是一个核心但相互关联的因素。遗传、表观遗传、环境和过敏都会影响易感性、疾病负担和对感染的反应,强调需要一种涵盖分子机制和人群流行病学的综合方法。关于病毒感染和小儿哮喘发展之间的联系,仍有几个重要问题有待解决。未来需要纵向研究来阐明病毒感染、表观遗传修饰和哮喘发展之间的因果关系。更大规模、更多样化的遗传学研究可能有助于识别强大的易感性标记并揭示适合干预的生物途径。为了充分描述病毒感染和哮喘之间的联系机制,可能需要结合基因组、表观基因组、免疫学、环境和临床数据的综合方法。此外,RSV 预防方面的最新进展,包括孕产妇免疫和长效单克隆抗体,为评估减少生命早期病毒性疾病是否可以改变呼吸道健康轨迹并降低随后发生哮喘的风险提供了前所未有的机会 (15,16)。总之,本研究主题中汇总的贡献强调了病毒感染在儿童哮喘中的作用。通过检查遗传易感性、表观遗传调控、流行病学趋势和过敏致敏,这些研究增进了我们对病毒暴露与哮喘发展和恶化之间复杂途径的理解。该领域持续的跨学科研究对于制定更有效的儿童哮喘预防和管理策略并最终减轻该疾病的全球负担至关重要。

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述探讨了为什么一些儿童会出现严重的病毒性呼吸道感染和哮喘等长期后遗症,重点关注宿主遗传和表观遗传因素、病毒流行病学以及儿科人群的过敏反应(A1、A6、A14)。它探讨了病毒感染如何与宿主特异性生物决定因素相互作用以影响儿童的易感性、疾病严重程度和哮喘结果的核心问题(A1、A6、A14)。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该社论综合了多项研究的结果,但没有进行正式的系统评价或荟萃分析。它参考了队列研究和前瞻性研究,调查了 RSV 住院的遗传易感性 (A3)、RSV 与哮喘相关的表观遗传机制 (A6)、COVID-19 封锁后病毒流行病学的变化 (A16) 以及中国哮喘儿童的过敏原敏化模式 (A25)。该综述不报告数据库、检索日期、资格标准或研究计数(A2、A6、A16、A25)。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该综述得出的结论是,宿主遗传因素影响对严重 RSV 感染的易感性,初步证据表明遗传变异与住院风险增加相关 (A4、A5)。它还强调了新出现的证据表明,RSV 感染可能会引起表观遗传变化,例如 DNA 甲基化和组蛋白修饰,这可能在机制上将生命早期病毒暴露与免疫反应和气道功能的长期变化联系起来 (A8、A9、A10)。此外,病毒感染仍然是儿童哮喘发病的主要诱因,大流行后病毒循环的变化已证明对疾病严重程度具有动态影响(A14、A18、A19、A23)。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 严重 RSV 感染与后期哮喘发展之间的关联机制仍存在争议,需要进一步研究 (A7)。该评论指出,虽然流行病学研究一致报告了这种关联,但暂时性病毒暴露与持续性呼吸道疾病之间的生物学途径尚未完全了解(A7、A8)。它还强调需要进行更大规模、更多样化的遗传学研究,以确定可靠的易感性标记,并阐明病毒感染、表观遗传修饰和哮喘发展之间的因果关系(A34、A35)。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该综述强调需要进行纵向研究来阐明病毒感染、表观遗传修饰和哮喘发展之间的因果关系(A34)。它还呼吁采用结合基因组、表观基因组、免疫学、环境和临床数据的综合方法,以充分描述病毒感染和哮喘之间的联系机制(A36)。建议将病毒循环监测作为预测儿童哮喘风险增加时期的重要工具,特别是在公共卫生措施转变期间 (A23)。

papers.title: Concordance between nasopharyngeal swab and bronchoalveolar lavage PCR for respiratory viruses.
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVES: We aimed to compare the diagnostic performance of nasopharyngeal (NP) swab and bronchoalveolar lavage (BAL) polymerase chain reaction (PCR) assays for respiratory viruses (RVs) in intensive care unit (ICU) patients with severe pneumonia. METHODS: Using prospective cohort data, we analyzed paired NP swab and BAL samples from 968 adult ICU patients between January 2010 and December 2023. Agreement between the two sampling methods was assessed using Cohen's κ coefficient. Diagnostic performance metrics, including sensitivity, specificity, positive predictive value (PPV), and negative predictive value (NPV), for NP swab PCR were calculated using BAL PCR as the reference standard. RESULTS: Among 968 patients, 318 (32.9%) tested positive for one or more RVs. Concordance between NP swab and BAL PCR was observed in 86.2% of paired samples. Cohen's κ indicated strong agreement (κ = 0.80-0.90) for respiratory syncytial virus, human metapneumovirus, and SARS-CoV-2, and moderate agreement (κ = 0.60-0.79) for rhinovirus, influenza virus, parainfluenza virus, and enterovirus. While specificity (97.4-100%) and NPV (97.8-100%) were consistently high across all viruses, sensitivity (47.4-100%) and PPV (33.3-100%) showed substantial variability by pathogen. CONCLUSIONS: NP swab PCR demonstrated high concordance with BAL PCR and uniformly high NPVs, supporting its utility as a first-line diagnostic tool for severe respiratory viral pneumonia. However, because NP swab PCR provides no information on bacterial or fungal pathogens, BAL remains an essential complementary modality when NP swab results are negative but clinical suspicion persists, or when co-existing or alternative etiologies are suspected.

source_records.title: Concordance between nasopharyngeal swab and bronchoalveolar lavage PCR for respiratory viruses.
source_records.abstract: OBJECTIVES: We aimed to compare the diagnostic performance of nasopharyngeal (NP) swab and bronchoalveolar lavage (BAL) polymerase chain reaction (PCR) assays for respiratory viruses (RVs) in intensive care unit (ICU) patients with severe pneumonia. METHODS: Using prospective cohort data, we analyzed paired NP swab and BAL samples from 968 adult ICU patients between January 2010 and December 2023. Agreement between the two sampling methods was assessed using Cohen's κ coefficient. Diagnostic performance metrics, including sensitivity, specificity, positive predictive value (PPV), and negative predictive value (NPV), for NP swab PCR were calculated using BAL PCR as the reference standard. RESULTS: Among 968 patients, 318 (32.9%) tested positive for one or more RVs. Concordance between NP swab and BAL PCR was observed in 86.2% of paired samples. Cohen's κ indicated strong agreement (κ = 0.80-0.90) for respiratory syncytial virus, human metapneumovirus, and SARS-CoV-2, and moderate agreement (κ = 0.60-0.79) for rhinovirus, influenza virus, parainfluenza virus, and enterovirus. While specificity (97.4-100%) and NPV (97.8-100%) were consistently high across all viruses, sensitivity (47.4-100%) and PPV (33.3-100%) showed substantial variability by pathogen. CONCLUSIONS: NP swab PCR demonstrated high concordance with BAL PCR and uniformly high NPVs, supporting its utility as a first-line diagnostic tool for severe respiratory viral pneumonia. However, because NP swab PCR provides no information on bacterial or fungal pathogens, BAL remains an essential complementary modality when NP swab results are negative but clinical suspicion persists, or when co-existing or alternative etiologies are suspected.

papers.abstract_zh: 目的:我们的目的是比较鼻咽(NP)拭子和支气管肺泡灌洗(BAL)聚合酶链反应(PCR)检测对重症监护病房(ICU)重症肺炎患者呼吸道病毒(RV)的诊断性能。方法:使用前瞻性队列数据,我们分析了 2010 年 1 月至 2023 年 12 月期间 968 名成人 ICU 患者的配对 NP 拭子和 BAL 样本。使用 Cohen κ 系数评估两种采样方法之间的一致性。使用 BAL PCR 作为参考标准计算 NP 拭子 PCR 的诊断性能指标,包括敏感性、特异性、阳性预测值 (PPV) 和阴性预测值 (NPV)。结果:在 968 名患者中,318 名患者 (32.9%) 的一种或多种 RV 检测呈阳性。在 86.2% 的配对样本中观察到 NP 拭子和 BAL PCR 之间的一致性。Cohen 的 κ 表明呼吸道合胞病毒、人偏肺病毒和 SARS-CoV-2 具有很强的一致性(κ = 0.80-0.90),而鼻病毒、流感病毒、副流感病毒和肠道病毒的一致性中等(κ = 0.60-0.79)。虽然所有病毒的特异性 (97.4-100%) 和 NPV (97.8-100%) 始终较高,但敏感性 (47.4-100%) 和 PPV (33.3-100%) 显示出不同病原体的显着差异。结论:NP 拭子 PCR 与 BAL PCR 高度一致,且 NPV 一致较高,支持其作为严重呼吸道病毒性肺炎的一线诊断工具。然而,由于 NP 拭子 PCR 无法提供有关细菌或真菌病原体的信息,因此当 NP 拭子结果呈阴性但临床怀疑仍然存在,或者怀疑共存或替代病因时,BAL 仍然是一种重要的补充方式。

papers.title: Demographic and Clinical Determinants of Acute Bronchiolitis Outcomes in a Tertiary Pediatric Hospital in Dubai, United Arab Emirates
papers.abstract: Background: Bronchiolitis is a lower respiratory tract infection that affects children under two years of age and is considered a cause of increased morbidity and healthcare costs, especially during the winter season. Despite its global burden, evidence on how local demographic or clinical factors influence outcomes in Middle Eastern populations remains limited. Objectives: This study aims to examine the descriptive epidemiology and different demographic and clinical characteristics of patients admitted with bronchiolitis, and to evaluate exploratory associations between these characteristics and various clinical outcomes, including duration of hospital admission, need for pediatric intensive care unit (PICU) admission, and need for invasive oxygen supplementation. Methods: This retrospective study included all infants aged 1-24 months who were admitted with bronchiolitis between October 1, 2022, and March 31, 2023. Electronic records from Cerner and Salama (Epic) were screened. Variables extracted included age at presentation, sex, nationality, gestational age, feeding type, family history of atopy, viral PCR results, initial oxygen saturation, and therapies received. Primary outcomes were PICU admission, maximum oxygen support, and length of stay. Associations were assessed using chi‐square or Fisher’s exact tests for categorical variables and Mann-Whitney U tests for continuous variables, with significance set at p < 0.05. Results: Of 1,804 screened encounters, 232 patients were eligible for the study. The mean (± SD) age was 6.6 ± 5.2 months, and 138 patients (59.5%) were male. Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) was detected in 101 patients (43.5%), rhinovirus/enterovirus in 29 patients (12.5%), and mixed/other viruses in 53 patients (22.8%). A high-flow nasal cannula was used in 87 cases (37.5%), but only 14 patients (6.1%) required PICU admission. None of the demographic or clinical factors showed a statistically significant effect on the chance of PICU admission or oxygen requirement. A family history of atopy was the only factor associated with a shorter length of stay (Mann-Whitney U = 2503.5; p = 0.008). Steroid therapy was more frequently administered to infants requiring greater oxygen support (chi-square = 13.971; p < 0.001), but did not shorten hospital stays or reduce PICU admissions. Conclusions: In this cohort from the United Arab Emirates, bronchiolitis outcomes were largely independent of demographic factors, viral etiology, or corticosteroid use. Adherence to international guidelines, which advocate for supportive care and discourage the routine use of glucocorticoids or bronchodilators, is likely to improve resource utilization without compromising outcomes.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:细支气管炎是一种影响两岁以下儿童的下呼吸道感染,被认为是发病率和医疗费用增加的原因,特别是在冬季。尽管存在全球负担,但有关当地人口或临床因素如何影响中东人群结果的证据仍然有限。目的:本研究旨在检查毛细支气管炎患者的描述性流行病学以及不同的人口统计学和临床​​特征,并评估这些特征与各种临床结果之间的探索性关联,包括住院时间、入院儿科重症监护病房(PICU)的需要以及有创供氧的需要。方法:这项回顾性研究纳入了 2022 年 10 月 1 日至 2023 年 3 月 31 日期间因细支气管炎入院的所有 1-24 个月婴儿。对 Cerner 和 Salama (Epic) 的电子记录进行了筛选。提取的变量包括就诊年龄、性别、国籍、胎龄、喂养类型、过敏家族史、病毒 PCR 结果、初始氧饱和度和接受的治疗。主要结局是 PICU 入住、最大氧气支持和住院时间。使用卡方或 Fisher 精确检验对分类变量以及 Mann-Whitney U 检验对连续变量进行评估,显着性设置为 p < 0.05。结果:在 1,804 例筛查病例中,232 名患者符合研究资格。平均 (± SD) 年龄为 6.6 ± 5.2 个月,138 名患者 (59.5%) 为男性。101 名患者(43.5%)检测到呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV),29 名患者(12.5%)检测到鼻病毒/肠道病毒,53 名患者(22.8%)检测到混合/其他病毒。87例(37.5%)使用高流量鼻导管,但只有14例(6.1%)需要入住PICU。人口统计学或临床因素均未显示出对 PICU 入住机会或氧气需求有统计学上的显着影响。特应性家族史是与较短住院时间相关的唯一因素(Mann-Whitney U = 2503.5;p = 0.008)。类固醇治疗更频繁地用于需要更多氧气支持的婴儿(卡方 = 13.971;p < 0.001),但并没有缩短住院时间或减少 PICU 入院率。结论:在来自阿拉伯联合酋长国的队列中,细支气管炎的结果在很大程度上与人口因素、病毒病因或皮质类固醇的使用无关。遵守提倡支持性护理并阻止常规使用糖皮质激素或支气管扩张剂的国际指南可能会在不影响结果的情况下提高资源利用率。

papers.title: Quality Improvement Initiative to Reduce Inappropriate Viral Testing within the Pediatric Emergency Department.
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: The American Academy of Pediatrics Section on Emergency Medicine's Choosing Wisely Campaign includes recommendations discouraging comprehensive viral panel testing in children with suspected respiratory viral illness. In the year preceding project implementation, our free-standing pediatric emergency department (PED) ordered comprehensive respiratory pathogen panels (RPPs) in 11.9% of all visits, and 50% of those lacked a clinical indication. This project aimed to reduce the percentage of PED visits with RPP orders from 11.9% to 9% over a 6-month viral respiratory season. METHODS: We conducted four major interventions over 2 plan-do-study-act cycles. Interventions included developing a clinical guideline for viral testing, performing provider education, introducing a narrower-spectrum Quad (influenza A/B, COVID-19, and respiratory syncytial virus) polymerase chain reaction (PCR) test, and adding an order-entry indication requirement for RPPs, which also served as a just-in-time educational tool for providers. We tracked data via a clinical dashboard and through periodic chart reviews. RESULTS: Of the 43,283 patient visits during the project period, the percentage of PED RPP orders decreased from 11.9% at baseline to 6.8% during the intervention period and remained at 6.8% in the following respiratory season. The project had sustained cost savings of over $300,000 in RPP testing each year. The decrease in RPP orders did not lead to an increase in the cumulative use of other viral tests. CONCLUSIONS: This quality improvement initiative significantly improved and sustained comprehensive viral PCR testing practices in the PED without increasing the use of alternative respiratory viral testing.

papers.abstract_zh: 简介:美国儿科学会急诊医学科的明智选择运动提出了不鼓励对疑似呼吸道病毒性疾病儿童进行全面病毒检测的建议。在项目实施的前一年,我们的独立儿科急诊科 (PED) 在 11.9% 的就诊中订购了综合呼吸道病原体检测 (RPP),其中 50% 缺乏临床指征。该项目旨在在 6 个月的病毒性呼吸道疾病季节中,将 RPP 订单下 PED 就诊的比例从 11.9% 减少到 9%。方法:我们在 2 个计划-实施-研究-行动周期中进行了四次主要干预措施。干预措施包括制定病毒检测临床指南、开展提供者教育、引入窄谱 Quad(A/B 型流感、COVID-19 和呼吸道合胞病毒)聚合酶链反应 (PCR) 测试,以及增加 RPP 的订单输入指示要求,这也可作为提供者的即时教育工具。我们通过临床仪表板和定期图表审查来跟踪数据。结果:在项目期间的 43,283 名患者就诊中,PED RPP 命令的百分比从基线的 11.9% 下降到干预期间的 6.8%,并在接下来的呼吸季节保持在 6.8%。该项目每年在 RPP 测试中节省了超过 300,000 美元的成本。RPP订单的减少并没有导致其他病毒检测累计使用量的增加。结论:这项质量改进举措显着改善并维持了 PED 中全面的病毒 PCR 检测实践,而无需增加替代呼吸道病毒检测的使用。

papers.title: Characterisation of respiratory viral infections in hospitalised adults
papers.abstract: Respiratory viral infections (RVIs) are major causes of adult hospitalisation, but their clinical course is heterogeneous and only partly explained by viral aetiology. Previous studies have often examined individual pathogens, particularly influenza, severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), limiting understanding of shared clinical patterns across adult hospitalised RVI. This thesis investigated clinical and biological heterogeneity in adults hospitalised with acute respiratory illness (ARI) and polymerase chain reaction (PCR)-confirmed RVI. It used the Understanding Infection, Viral Exacerbation and Respiratory Symptoms at Admission-Longitudinal (UNIVERSAL) study, a prospective multicentre United Kingdom (UK) observational cohort of adults hospitalised with a broad range of RVIs, a pooled multicentre RSV cohort and a nested interleukin-33/serum stimulation 2 (IL-33/ST2) biomarker subcohort. Symptom composition differed across viral groups, particularly for fever-related and nasal symptom domains, whereas lower respiratory and systemic symptoms were near universal across virus groups. Strict World Health Organization severe acute respiratory infection (WHO SARI) criteria captured only part of the adult hospitalised RVI spectrum, with lower capture for SARS-CoV-2 and rhino/enterovirus (RhV/EV) than for influenza and RSV. Non-capture was driven mainly by absence of fever symptoms and symptom duration beyond 10 days. Latent class analysis identified three host-derived phenotypes: an asthma-eosinophilic phenotype with shorter pre-admission symptom duration, a multimorbid cardiorenal-inflammatory phenotype, and a chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) associated phenotype with prolonged pre-admission respiratory and systemic symptoms. These phenotypes cut across viral groups and were associated with severe disease, particularly sustained respiratory failure. In adults hospitalised with RSV, age-based thresholds aligned with current UK RSV vaccine eligibility showed limited post-admission prognostic discrimination. A model incorporating age, COPD, active or previous cancer and dementia provided more informative internally validated risk stratification, suggesting that poor-outcome risk is only partially captured by chronological age alone. In the biomarker subcohort, serum soluble ST2 (sST2) and the nasal oxidised:reduced IL-33 ratio were independently associated with severe disease after adjustment for viral group, suggesting complementary systemic and upper-airway host-response signals. Overall, this thesis shows that pathogen identity, WHO SARI classification and age thresholds provide clinically useful but incomplete perspectives on hospitalised adult RVI. By integrating symptom presentation, symptom duration, host phenotype, RSV post-admission risk and IL-33/ST2 biology, it provides a framework for broader hospital ARI surveillance, outcome stratification, and future biomarker-informed research.

papers.abstract_zh: 呼吸道病毒感染(RVI)是成人住院的主要原因,但其临床病程各不相同,并且只能部分由病毒病因学解释。先前的研究经常检查个体病原体,特别是流感、严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒 2 (SARS-CoV-2) 和呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV),限制了对成人住院 RVI 共同临床模式的了解。本论文研究了因急性呼吸道疾病 (ARI) 住院的成人患者的临床和生物学异质性以及经聚合酶链反应 (PCR) 确诊的 RVI。它使用了入院时了解感染、病毒恶化和呼吸道症状纵向 (UNIVERSAL) 研究、一项前瞻性多中心英国 (UK) 因各种 RVI 住院成人观察队列、一个汇总的多中心 RSV 队列和一个巢式白细胞介素 33/血清刺激 2 (IL-33/ST2) 生物标志物子队列。不同病毒组的症状构成不同,特别是与发烧相关和鼻部症状领域,而下呼吸道和全身症状在不同病毒组中几乎普遍存在。严格的世界卫生组织严重急性呼吸道感染 (WHO SARI) 标准仅涵盖了部分成人住院 RVI 谱系,其中 SARS-CoV-2 和犀牛/肠道病毒 (RhV/EV) 的捕获率低于流感和 RSV。未捕获的主要原因是没有发烧症状且症状持续时间超过 10 天。潜类别分析确定了三种源自宿主的表型:入院前症状持续时间较短的哮喘嗜酸性粒细胞表型、多病性心肾炎症表型以及入院前呼吸和全身症状延长的慢性阻塞性肺病(COPD)相关表型。这些表型跨越病毒组,并与严重疾病相关,特别是持续性呼吸衰竭。在因 RSV 住院的成人中,与当前英国 RSV 疫苗资格一致的基于年龄的阈值显示入院后预后歧视有限。纳入年龄、慢性阻塞性肺病、活动性或既往癌症和痴呆症的模型提供了更多信息,内部验证的风险分层,表明仅按实际年龄仅部分捕获不良结果风险。在生物标志物亚组中,血清可溶性 ST2 (sST2) 和鼻氧化:还原性 IL-33 比率在调整病毒组后与严重疾病独立相关,表明全身和上呼吸道宿主反应信号是互补的。总体而言,本文表明病原体身份、WHO SARI 分类和年龄阈值为住院成人 RVI 提供了临床上有用但不完整的观点。通过整合症状表现、症状持续时间、宿主表型、RSV 入院后风险和 IL-33/ST2 生物学,它为更广泛的医院 ARI 监测、结果分层和未来的生物标志物研究提供了一个框架。

papers.title: Mechanism and spectrum of inhibition of viral polymerases by 2′-deoxy-2′-β-fluoro-4′-azidocytidine or azvudine
papers.abstract: The therapeutic value of antiviral nucleoside analogs was highlighted during the coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic, with remdesivir and molnupiravir repurposed for their broad-spectrum antiviral activity. The cytidine analog azvudine (FNC) has recently gained attention as a potential treatment for human immunodeficiency virus type 1 (HIV-1) and severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) infection. Considering the distinct substrate specificities of HIV-1 reverse transcriptase (RT) and SARS-CoV-2 RNA-dependent RNA polymerase (RdRp), a unifying mechanism of inhibition remains elusive. Here, we assessed the inhibitory effects of FNC’s active triphosphate form, FNC-TP, across several viral polymerases. The relative efficiency of FNC-TP incorporation followed the order: HIV-1 RT > hepatitis C virus (HCV) RdRp > respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) RdRp > dengue virus type 2 (DENV-2) RdRp ≫ SARS-CoV-2 RdRp. Its incorporation caused chain-termination in all polymerases tested. Antiviral activity against HIV-1 has previously been demonstrated and is here shown with DENV-2. Collectively, the data show that inhibition of viral polymerases by FNC-TP can translate to antiviral activity against both retroviruses and RNA viruses, but the link is not evident for SARS-CoV-2. FNC-TP is a poor substrate for SARS-CoV-2 RdRp, and FNC lacks significant antiviral activity against SARS-CoV-2 in cell culture.

papers.abstract_zh: 抗病毒核苷类似物的治疗价值在 2019 年冠状病毒病 (COVID-19) 大流行期间得到强调,瑞德西韦和莫努匹拉韦因其广谱抗病毒活性而被重新利用。胞苷类似物阿兹夫定 (FNC) 最近作为治疗人类免疫缺陷病毒 1 型 (HIV-1) 和严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒 2 (SARS-CoV-2) 感染的潜在疗法而受到关注。考虑到 HIV-1 逆转录酶 (RT) 和 SARS-CoV-2 RNA 依赖性 RNA 聚合酶 (RdRp) 不同的底物特异性,统一的抑制机制仍然难以捉摸。在这里,我们评估了 FNC 的活性三磷酸盐形式 FNC-TP 对几种病毒聚合酶的抑制作用。FNC-TP掺入的相对效率遵循以下顺序:HIV-1 RT>丙型肝炎病毒(HCV)RdRp>呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)RdRp>登革热病毒2型(DENV-2)RdRp≫SARS-CoV-2 RdRp。它的掺入导致所有测试的聚合酶链终止。针对 HIV-1 的抗病毒活性先前已得到证实,此处显示了 DENV-2 的抗病毒活性。总的来说,数据表明,FNC-TP 对病毒聚合酶的抑制可以转化为针对逆转录病毒和 RNA 病毒的抗病毒活性,但对于 SARS-CoV-2,这种联系并不明显。FNC-TP 是 SARS-CoV-2 RdRp 的较差底物,并且 FNC 在细胞培养物中缺乏针对 SARS-CoV-2 的显着抗病毒活性。

papers.title: Development of a self-regulating paper-based microfluidic platform for instrument-free molecular diagnostics
papers.abstract: This thesis addresses the engineering gap between laboratory-based nucleic-acid amplification tests and low-cost lateral-flow diagnostics by developing an instrument-free paper-based platform for amplified respiratory-virus detection. The work investigated three linked technological questions: whether a printed positive temperature coefficient ink heater could passively maintain the target thermal window without active feedback electronics; whether a dot-array nucleic-acid lateral-flow architecture could reduce the spatial and reagent-depletion limitations of conventional multi-line strips; and whether a thermally actuated wax gate could create a passive time delay to synchronise amplification with downstream detection. A stencil-printed paper heater combining silver interdigitated electrodes with carbon-based positive temperature coefficient ink was developed and tuned for low-voltage operation. The heater exploited the intrinsic resistance increase of the composite to provide passive thermal regulation within the compatible range. A five-target dot-array lateral-flow strip was then developed for SARS-CoV-2, Influenza A/B and RSV A/B amplicons. Compared with the conventional line format, the dot-array layout reduced downstream signal depletion and enabled compact multiplex readout. On-paper amplification studies identified cellulose filter paper as a more suitable amplification and amplicon-release matrix than glass fibre. Finally, a thermally coupled wax-gate device was developed in which gate width programmed the actuation delay, allowing amplification products to be released only after the incubation period. The integrated single-target prototype detected Influenza B synthetic DNA at an observed limit of detection of 200 copies total input. The work is presented as proof-of-principle engineering using synthetic DNA templates only; no recovery, extraction or purification of nucleic acids from clinical samples was performed. The thesis contributes design rules for printed self-regulating heating, dot-array nucleic-acid lateral-flow multiplexing, and passive thermal-fluidic synchronisation for future sample-to-answer paper diagnostics.

papers.title_zh: 开发用于无仪器分子诊断的自调节纸基微流控平台
papers.source_body_en: This thesis addresses the engineering gap between laboratory-based nucleic-acid amplification tests and low-cost lateral-flow diagnostics by developing an instrument-free paper-based platform for amplified respiratory-virus detection. The work investigated three linked technological questions: whether a printed positive temperature coefficient ink heater could passively maintain the target thermal window without active feedback electronics; whether a dot-array nucleic-acid lateral-flow architecture could reduce the spatial and reagent-depletion limitations of conventional multi-line strips; and whether a thermally actuated wax gate could create a passive time delay to synchronise amplification with downstream detection. A stencil-printed paper heater combining silver interdigitated electrodes with carbon-based positive temperature coefficient ink was developed and tuned for low-voltage operation. The heater exploited the intrinsic resistance increase of the composite to provide passive thermal regulation within the compatible range. A five-target dot-array lateral-flow strip was then developed for SARS-CoV-2, Influenza A/B and RSV A/B amplicons. Compared with the conventional line format, the dot-array layout reduced downstream signal depletion and enabled compact multiplex readout. On-paper amplification studies identified cellulose filter paper as a more suitable amplification and amplicon-release matrix than glass fibre. Finally, a thermally coupled wax-gate device was developed in which gate width programmed the actuation delay, allowing amplification products to be released only after the incubation period. The integrated single-target prototype detected Influenza B synthetic DNA at an observed limit of detection of 200 copies total input. The work is presented as proof-of-principle engineering using synthetic DNA templates only; no recovery, extraction or purification of nucleic acids from clinical samples was performed. The thesis contributes design rules for printed self-regulating heating, dot-array nucleic-acid lateral-flow multiplexing, and passive thermal-fluidic synchronisation for future sample-to-answer paper diagnostics.
papers.abstract_zh: 本论文通过开发一种用于扩增呼吸道病毒检测的无仪器纸质平台,解决了基于实验室的核酸扩增测试和低成本侧流诊断之间的工程差距。这项工作研究了三个相关的技术问题:印刷正温度系数墨水加热器是否可以在没有主动反馈电子设备的情况下被动地维持目标热窗口;点阵列核酸侧流架构是否可以减少传统多线试纸条的空间和试剂消耗限制;以及热驱动蜡门是否可以产生被动时间延迟以使扩增与下游检测同步。开发了一种将银叉指电极与碳基正温度系数墨水相结合的模板印刷纸加热器,并针对低电压运行进行了调整。该加热器利用复合材料固有的电阻增加来提供兼容范围内的被动热调节。随后针对 SARS-CoV-2、A/B 型流感和 RSV A/B 扩增子开发了五靶点点阵侧流试纸条。与传统的行格式相比,点阵列布局减少了下游信号损耗并实现了紧凑的多路读出。纸上扩增研究发现,纤维素滤纸是比玻璃纤维更合适的扩增和扩增子释放基质。最后,开发了一种热耦合蜡门装置,其中门宽度对驱动延迟进行编程,允许扩增产物仅在孵育期后释放。集成的单靶标原型以 200 个拷贝的总输入量的观察检测限检测到了 B 型流感合成 DNA。这项工作仅使用合成 DNA 模板进行原理验证工程;未对临床样品中的核酸进行回收、提取或纯化。该论文为未来样本到答卷诊断的印刷自调节加热、点阵核酸侧流多重检测和被动热流体同步提供了设计规则。

papers.title: Biomarkers and Risk Factors Associated with Apnea in Hospitalized Infants with Acute Respiratory Infection
papers.abstract: Apnea is a potentially life-threatening complication of severe acute respiratory infection (SARI) in early infancy; however, its determinants remain incompletely understood. Between 2011 and 2013, we conducted a population-based, cross-sectional, multicenter study in Buenos Aires, Argentina. We examined epidemiological, clinical, virological, and immunological factors associated with apnea in a population-based cohort of 2376 infants younger than five months hospitalized due to SARI. Using hierarchical multivariable logistic regression, we identified preterm birth, cesarean section, previous NICU admission, age under two months, and severe household crowding as independent predictors of apnea. RSV infection was inversely associated with apnea, and IL-5 levels in respiratory secretions were significantly lower among infants with apnea, suggesting a qualitatively different immune response in this group. Taken together, these findings indicate that apnea during SARI in early infancy is primarily driven by biological immaturity and adverse environmental conditions.
authors: on behalf of The INFANT Respiratory Network

papers.abstract_zh: 呼吸暂停是婴儿早期严重急性呼吸道感染 (SARI) 的一种可能危及生命的并发症;然而,其决定因素仍不完全清楚。2011 年至 2013 年间,我们在阿根廷布宜诺斯艾利斯进行了一项基于人群的横断面多中心研究。我们在一个由 2376 名因 SARI 住院的 5 个月以下婴儿组成的人群队列中检查了与呼吸暂停相关的流行病学、临床、病毒学和免疫学因素。使用分层多变量逻辑回归,我们确定早产、剖腹产、既往 NICU 入住、年龄不到两个月和严重的家庭拥挤是呼吸暂停的独立预测因素。RSV 感染与呼吸暂停呈负相关,患有呼吸暂停的婴儿呼吸道分泌物中的 IL-5 水平显着较低,表明该组婴儿的免疫反应存在质的不同。总而言之,这些发现表明婴儿早期 SARI 期间的呼吸暂停主要是由生物不成熟和不利的环境条件引起的。

papers.title: Epidemiology, Clinical Characteristics, and Severity of Human Parainfluenza Virus Infection in Children from 2015-2025: A Scoping Review Protocol
papers.abstract: The objective of this scoping review is to identify and map the available evidence on the epidemiology, clinical characteristics, and severity of HPIV infection in hospitalised children, and to identify comparisons within HPIV serotypes, with other respiratory viruses and risk factors for severe outcomes. Expected outcomes: - Evidence on the epidemiology, clinical characteristics, and severity of human parainfluenza virus (HPIV) infection in hospitalised children from 2015-2025 - The differences between HPIV serotypes (HPIV 1-4) in terms of epidemiology and clinical presentation - Comparison with other common respiratory viruses (e.g., RSV, influenza, human metapneumovirus) in terms of epidemiology and clinical severity - Risk factors associated with severe outcomes/re-admission of HPIV infection in children

news.content_title: Respiratory Syncytial Virus: The Unknown Threat Our Children Face — Dr Azanna Ahmad Kamar
news.content: About Us Malaysia World Animals Opinions Contact Us About Us Malaysia World Animals Opinions Contact Us Respiratory Syncytial Virus: The Unknown Threat Our Children Face — Dr Azanna Ahmad Kamar By CodeBlue | 17 July 2026 Like many other respiratory diseases, RSV is highly contagious – among infants, two out of three children experience their first infection before 12 months of age. Image by Magnific. We are now seeing fewer devastating infections due to the robust childhood immunisation programme enforced by most nations. However, one of the threats faced by children and families is the persistence of infections that are associated with childhood respiratory tract problems, as well as wheezing disorders. One of these is Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV). As a paediatrician, I have witnessed firsthand the distress that RSV can cause in our young patients, the anxiety it creates for their families, and the long-term effects that the condition can cause making the conversation around RSV even more important. RSV is present year-round and typically peaks toward the end of the year (September to December), with cases often extending into January the following year. Like many other respiratory diseases, it is highly contagious – among infants, two out of three children experience their first infection before 12 months of age. However, many parents may not have been made aware of its existence. An Overlooked Threat RSV can infect anyone, of any age, spreading through droplets from infected persons, and causing only mild symptoms in healthy older children and adults. However, its impact on young children is much more severe. In Malaysia, RSV is the most commonly identified respiratory virus in the most vulnerable of children aged six months and below, accounting for 81.3% of viral respiratory tract infections (RTI). A typical daily paediatric ward round will most certainly have an infant with an RSV-related RTI. Infants who are born premature and those with congenital disorders such as congenital cardiac malformations, neurological disorders, or other comorbid conditions are more likely to experience severe illness. However, healthy babies born at full term are not spared, as more than 80% of severe cases involve children with no underlying health conditions. Parents may find that symptoms such as cough, runny nose, and fever overlap with other common childhood illnesses, making RSV difficult to be distinguished from other respiratory diseases. Infants and young children may also exhibit poor appetite or lethargy. While these may be dismissed as unimportant, symptoms can rapidly worsen to include both rapid or shallow breathing, shortness of breath and spasms in the airways known as bronchospasms. The child can look to be in distress with snuffles, chest indrawing, persistent cough, poor feeding, wheezing, rattles within the chest plus discomfort, signifying the need for medical attention, as RSV can also trigger serious complications such as pneumonia and inflammation of the small airways in the lung. It is unsurprising, therefore, that 84.5 per cent of infected children below two years old result in hospitalisation and a significant proportion of these involve healthy, full-term babies. Moreover, some of these babies require urgent breathing support or ICU care. Local studies have demonstrated the need for mechanical ventilation may range between 2.5 and 6.9 per cent, impacting on hospital resources. Direct medical and indirect non-medical expenditures due to RSV-associated hospitalisation is high and is estimated to cost USD756 for a median hospital stay of four days. This includes indirect costs such as parental income loss, which may eventually overwhelm the health care budget, especially if a “seasonal” nursery outbreak were to occur. These facts inform us that RSV can affect any child, placing a high burden on health care resources. Preventive Steps For The Present And The Future Keeping young children safe from RSV, therefore, is essential. However, just as awareness of RSV remains low, so is knowledge of its lasting impact and most importantly, of what parents can do as preventive steps. RSV is a perennial problem, and the burden of RSV can linger for a long time after the initial infection, long after a child has recovered. Studies show that children who suffer an RSV infection face up to 12 times higher risk of developing asthma and may be affected by long-term respiratory problems such as recurrent wheezing and abnormal lung function. What’s more, getting infected once doesn’t provide immunity, so it’s possible to get infected again. This means that we cannot afford to be complacent, and that the society must take the necessary actions to prevent RSV. A good place to start for new parents is by ensuring that their babies are breastfed. Human milk contains numerous immune and antiviral components which can help protect infants against various infections. A review has found that infants who were not breastfed, or breastfed for shorter durations, had significantly higher risks of severe RSV-associated lower respiratory tract infections. Another essential practice is by ensuring good hygiene such as regular handwashing and wearing face masks, as well as by avoiding close contact or sharing utensils with those who are unwell. Parents are also encouraged to keep unwell children out of school or child care to prevent infecting other children and, by extension, their families. Child care facilities should not be overcrowded as this is a known risk factor for recurrent infections. All child minders need to ensure that surfaces remain clean and disinfected and that a smoke-free environment is maintained for all babies. As a doctor who has seen the impact of RSV on children, I therefore urge all parents to take the first step by speaking with your paediatrician to learn about RSV prevention. Talk about the preventive steps mentioned and immunisation options, including maternal vaccination which passes antibodies to the unborn child, and childhood immunisation with monoclonal antibodies which provides ready-made effective protection directly to babies from birth until one year old or more. RSV infection is a preventable threat. Taking these initial steps are essential to ensure that we can prevent a lifetime of RSV-associated complications, and ultimately, for our country, reduce any adverse socioeconomic impact that an RSV-associated outbreak can have. Dr Azanna Ahmad Kamar is a consultant neonatologist and paediatrician at the Department of Paediatrics, Faculty of Medicine, University of Malaya. news.title: High Risk for RSV Found in Closed Community Settings With Children
news.excerpt: Closed community settings that include children are associated with a high risk for respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) transmission.

news.content: Menu SECTIONS News Features CME Conferences Clinical Quiz Clinical Tools Special Collections Multimedia Fact Sheets Diagnosis & Disease Info Topics Allergies Critical Care Medicine Disorders of Sleep and Breathing Disorders of the Pulmonary Circulation General Medicine General Pulmonology Lung Cancer Obstructive Lung Diseases Pleural and Mediastinal Disorders Practice Management Respiratory Infectious Disease Restrictive Lung Diseases Haymarket Medical Network Cancer Therapy AdvisorClinical AdvisorClinical Pain AdvisorDermatology AdvisorEndocrinology AdvisorGastroenterology AdvisorHematology AdvisorInfectious Disease AdvisorMedical BagMPRNeurology AdvisorOncology Nurse AdvisorOphthalmology AdvisorOptometry AdvisorPsychiatry AdvisorPulmonology AdvisorRare Disease AdvisorRenal and Urology NewsRheumatology AdvisorSleep Wake AdvisorThe Cardiology AdvisorVaccine Advisor Search for: News Calculators Charts CME Drugs Resources Meetings Multimedia Part of the News and Features CME Conferences Clinical Tools Special Collections Multimedia Share this article Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Share on LinkedIn Share by Email Print Respiratory Infectious Disease High Risk for RSV Found in Closed Community Settings With Children Colby Stong | Publish Date July 15, 2026 Studies of RSV secondary attack rates (SAR) in community settings with children showed a trend of increasing SAR with decreasing age. Closed community settings that include children are associated with a high risk for respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) transmission, according to study findings published in Influenza and Other Respiratory Viruses. Investigators conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis of evidence on RSV transmission in closed communities with children. Multiple databases were searched from inception to March 2025 for studies that reported primary data on RSV transmission within defined cohorts in closed community settings that included children aged younger than 18 years. The researchers sought studies with RSV secondary attack rates (SAR) or other RSV attack rates or appropriate data to calculate the rates. Acute RSV infection in the studies was confirmed with use of laboratory testing. The primary outcome was RSV SAR. [Y]ounger age, the presence of symptoms and longer duration of shedding were identified as key factors associated with increased risk of secondary transmission. The analysis included 38 articles with 30 unique study populations. The studies published data from 1956 to 2023 in 12 countries (17 studies from the United States). Settings included households (19/30, 63.3%), early childhood education and care (ECEC) centers (6/30, 20.0%), and long-term residential care facilities (5/30, 16.7%). Based on 8 studies, pooled analysis yielded an SAR of 23.8% (95% CI, 16.5%-31.0%) with substantial heterogeneity among the studies (I2=96.9%, P <.001). Sensitivity subgroup analyses that stratified SAR according to reported vs calculated rates produced increased pooled estimates for reported SARs (n=6, 29.6%; 95% CI, 17.7%-41.4%). Among children aged younger than 5 years in 6 studies, the pooled SAR was 26.8% (95% CI, 15.5%-38.2%; I2=89.1%; P <.001) and 34.4% (95% CI, 13.9%-55.0%) in sensitivity subgroup analysis. The studies showed a trend of increasing SAR with decreasing age. Outbreak attack rates were obtained from ECEC, residential care, and household studies with a follow-up of 8 days to 1 month. The pooled outbreak attack rate in the ECEC and residential care settings (n=8) was 59.2% (95% CI, 31.7%-86.8%; I2=97.2%). Seasonal attack rates were based on household and ECEC studies with a follow-up ranging from 2 months to 1 year. The pooled seasonal attack rate based on households (n=10) was 14.9% (95% CI, 10.6%-19.1%, I2=98%). Among the 38 included articles, 19 (50.0%) were considered high quality, 17 (44.7%) medium quality, and 2 (5.3%) low quality. Considerable heterogeneity was observed for the quality domains of selection, comparability, and outcome. Limitations include the small number of studies and substantial between-study heterogeneity, the potential for misclassification of parameters and outcomes, and inconsistent use of attack rate terminology. “[T]he included studies illustrate the high risk of RSV transmission in household, ECEC and residential care settings. Younger age is clearly correlated with increased susceptibility to infection, whereas younger age, the presence of symptoms and longer duration of shedding were identified as key factors associated with increased risk of secondary transmission,” the researchers stated. Disclosure: Some of the study authors declared affiliations with biotech, pharmaceutical, and/or device companies. Please see the original reference for a full list of authors’ disclosures. References: Saravanos GL, Takashima M, El-Heneidy A, et al. Respiratory syncytial virus transmission in closed community settings that include children: a systematic review and meta-analysis. news.title_zh: 在有儿童的封闭社区环境中发现 RSV 的高风险
news.source_body_en: A systematic review and meta-analysis published on July 15, 2026, found that closed community settings with children, such as households, early childhood education and care centers, and residential care facilities, pose a high risk for respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) transmission. The pooled secondary attack rate was 23.8%, with higher rates observed in children under 5 years (26.8%). Factors increasing transmission risk include younger age, symptom presence, and longer viral shedding duration. The study, based on 38 articles from 12 countries, noted substantial heterogeneity among studies.
news.content_zh: 2026 年 7 月 15 日发表的一项系统回顾和荟萃分析发现,有儿童的封闭社区环境,例如家庭、幼儿教育和护理中心以及住宿护理设施,存在呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 传播的高风险。合并继发性发作率为 23.8%,其中 5 岁以下儿童的继发性发作率更高 (26.8%)。增加传播风险的因素包括年龄较小、出现症状和病毒传播持续时间较长。该研究基于来自 12 个国家的 38 篇文章,指出研究之间存在很大的异质性。
news.summary_zh: 2026 年 7 月 15 日发表的一项系统回顾和荟萃分析发现,有儿童的封闭社区环境,例如家庭、幼儿教育和护理中心以及住宿护理设施,存在呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 传播的高风险。合并继发性发作率为 23.8%,其中 5 岁以下儿童的继发性发作率更高 (26.8%)。增加传播风险的因素包括年龄较小、出现症状和病毒传播持续时间较长。该研究基于来自 12 个国家的 38 篇文章,指出研究之间存在很大的异质性。

analysis_zh.time: 该研究结果基于对 1956 年至 2023 年证据的系统回顾和荟萃分析,于 2026 年 7 月 15 日发表。
analysis_zh.location_and_population: 该分析包括来自 12 个国家的 38 篇文章,其中 17 项研究来自美国。这些环境包括家庭(63.3%)、幼儿教育和护理中心(20.0%)以及长期住宿护理机构(16.7%)。人口包括 18 岁以下的儿童,特别关注 5 岁以下的儿童。
analysis_zh.event: 进行了系统回顾和荟萃分析,以调查呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)在儿童封闭社区环境中的传播情况。该研究发现这些环境中 RSV 传播的风险很高。
analysis_zh.scale_impact_and_risk: The pooled secondary attack rate (SAR) was 23.8% (95% CI, 16.5%-31.0%). In children younger than 5 years, the pooled SAR was 26.8% (95% CI, 15.5%-38.2%). Outbreak attack rates in ECEC and residential care settings were 59.2% (95% CI, 31.7%-86.8%). The risk of transmission increases with younger age, presence of symptoms, and longer duration of viral shedding.
analysis_zh.response_status_and_uncertainty: 该研究是一项系统回顾和荟萃分析,但存在局限性,包括研究之间存在显着的异质性(I2=96.9%)和参数潜在的错误分类。纳入研究的质量参差不齐,50% 的研究质量为高质量,44.7% 的研究质量为中等,5.3% 的研究质量为低质量。
